articleTitle: Business Continuity Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Increased competition in the markets of goods and services associated with the development of science and technology dictates the need for the organization not only to plan and respond to incidents and failures to continue business activities at an acceptable predetermined level, but also in a predetermined recovery target to achieve a full restoration of normal activities in the event of a devastating incident. The article shows some areas of improvement of existing and creation of new tools and methods focused on the creation and maintenance of a holistic management process that determines the potential threats to the Organization and the possible level of impact on business activities, which is aimed at ensuring business sustainability and effective response, providing protection of the interests of key project participants, reputation, brand and activities to create added value.

articleTitle: Digital Technology and Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Development of science and technology requires the development of new methods of quality management. Along with already existing methods and quality management systems new approaches. Article showing some areas for improvement of the existing and creation of new tools, techniques and quality management systems in the light of the development of digital technologies. In particular, the combination of known methods of quality management (TQM, Lean Production and other) and information technology (methods of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), CALS-technologies, ERP ( Enterprise Resource Planning), PDM-system (Product Data Management), MES (manufacturing execution system), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), EAM (Enterprise Asset Management systems) and others) allows you to create new principles for a modern quality management system.

Author Keywords: model of the integrated management system

articleTitle: Basics of Forming an Integrated Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article highlights the issues of forming an integrated management system based on the quality management system and including such branch systems as the information security system and the information services management system. The model of the integrated management system is developed and the stages of formation of the integrated management system are determined.

Author Keywords: model of the integrated management system

articleTitle: Analysis of Information Structure of the Corporate Network of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The approach to designing a corporate network of the enterprise with the use of business modeling and mathematical modeling of the information structure of the network is shown. The possibilities of using the analysis of the information structure of the network to determine the composition of hardware and software and optimize the network structure are shown. A method of describing the information structure of the network are advanced. Results can be useful to designers and administrators of corporate networks.

Author Keywords: design of corporate network of enterprise

articleTitle: Container Cluster Model Development for Legacy Applications Integration in Scientific Software System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Feature of modern scientific information systems is their integration with computing applications, providing distributed computer simulation and intellectual processing of Big Data using high-efficiency computing. Often these software systems include legacy applications in different programming languages, with non-standardized interfaces. To solve the problem of applications integration, containerization systems are using that allow to configure environment in the shortest time to deploy software system. However, there are no such systems for computer simulation systems with large number of nodes. The article considers the actual task of combining containers into a cluster, integrating legacy applications to manage the distributed software system MD-SLAG-MELT v.14, which supports high-performance computing and visualization of the computer experiments results. Testing results of the container cluster including automatic load sharing module for MD-SLAG-MELT system v.14. are given.

articleTitle: Estimation of Total Migration Time of Virtual Machines in Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Live migration of virtual machines is the transfer of a running virtual machine from one physical server to another with a short service downtime, usually invisible to users. Live migration is a costly operation, since it additionally loads servers and network, thus affecting the quality of service indicators and interferes with the monitoring of servers. Therefore, it is necessary to estimate the total migration time. In this paper, we propose a statistical method for estimating total migration time. This will allow to determine the optimal size of the server monitoring window.

articleTitle: The Safety Assessment of Critical Infrastructure Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper presents the problem of assessing the security of an automated system. An analysis of the evaluation of the security of an automated system that is based on international standards. The basic set of normative documents for analyzing the security of products and IT systems is the ISO/IEC 15408 series of standards, more commonly known in Russian terminology as "General Criteria".

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Big Data Technologies in the Financial Sphere
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The last years' global development is characterized by the mass introduction of information and communication technologies in all spheres of economic development. The implementation of digital technologies acquired explosive character recently. It is no coincidence that the term "digital economy", indicating the use of the most advanced digital technologies in various sectors of the world economy, has emerged in past years. Today, digital transformation occurs in virtually all areas of economic development, for example, Industry 4.0 in industry, Fintech in the financial sector. The main breakthrough technologies of digital transformation are cloud computing technology, cyber - physical systems, artificial intelligence, and technologies for analysis and processing of big data. One of the drivers of digital modernization is the big data direction. The rapid development of this sphere is explained by the intermittent growth of information, which leads to the impossibility of applying classical methods and tools for processing available data. The paper analyzes the technologies and methods of processing information in the field of big data. Future development of the sectors of the field of big data is given. The research of the big data market in various sectors of economic development was conducted; the leaders in this field are identified. The main directions of using big data in financial institutions as one of the key players in the market are analyzed. The study of the big data market in the financial sphere was carried out; financial indicators, dynamics of the market growth were determined. The main reasons that prevent the big data introduction in financial institutions are shown. The prognosis for the further development of the use of big data in the financial sphere is given.

articleTitle: Development of a Software Package Designed to Support Distance Education for Disabled People
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today, the society pays much attention to the problem of adapting people with disabilities, in particular, to improving the quality of their education and ways of teaching. The article describes the development of the software package "Surdotelephone" with the help of intelligent data processing technologies, such as machine learning methods, to help people with hearing impairments who receive distance education. The project provides recognition by dactyl of sign language.

articleTitle: The Enterprise’s Automated Management Stability System Taking into Account its Life Cycle Stage
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Elements of the automated enterprise sustainability management system are described, including its economic, social and environmental aspects. The target values of the enterprise development indicators are determined by the dynamics of its sustainability indicators, the influence of external and internal risks, as well as the enterprise's life cycle stage. Logical links of the automated system's structural elements are approved on the task of assessing the economic consequences of industrial injuries for the enterprise's life cycle stage "maturity". The system considers that the product profitability is reduced due to expenses related to occupational injury.

articleTitle: Databases Problems for Maritime Transport Industry on Platform Highload
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article says about distributed and highload systems, common problems and common instructions to solve in such as denormalization, replication and sharding for transport and maritime aspekts. The analysis of strengths and weaknesses of technology for the transport field of activity was carried out. A fragment of the code for sampling optimization is given. Conclusions are made about the global use of industry technology. When your current infrastructure starts showing the first signs that it stops coping with the load and if you have a 128 MB VPS - for you it can be 10 requests per second. For corporations, this can be 10,000 requests. There is a need for scaling and optimizing the infrastructure. For maritime office need a good monitoring system. It will help determine the very moment when it's time to scale. Stable systems for monitoring and tracking server performance trends: Munin, Zabbix, Nagios. What usually happens when the highload point approaches: slow or infinite loading of pages; random errors; broken connections from the Web server; partial loading of content (for example, there is no part of the images) and a decrease in audience activity. This direction is very modern for the transport industry and promising.

articleTitle: Using the NI ELVIS II Complex for Improvement of Laboratory Course in Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: computer aided instruction; educational courses; transportation; organisational aspects; innovation management; Internet; quality management; educational institutions; further education; production engineering computing.

articleTitle: Key Ways of Information Technologies for Self-Education Development. Pros and Cons
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to self-education development via modern information technologies implementation. Undoubtedly, that changings of self-education process based on modern technologies is significant, however, the most important impact it creates in remote regions. Among key pros of information technology usage are such benefits as system, enlargement of involved people number, behavior tracking as an opportunity to improve educational programs and material, people with some disabilities can be involved in education system and become a part of a system. However, they are some cons. The most significant is educational content quality and information search. Despite developed system of comments in the Internet, there is personal responsibility for content search and selection. It is important to search for educational information and expand the field of the search far from famous platforms.

articleTitle: The Approaches to the Design of Integrated Quality Management Systems for the Digital Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the approaches to the design of the integrated management systems of the digital enterprise (IMS) based on the methodology for the design of the corporate information systems, the design of enterprise architectures, system analysis, system and process modeling and the systems approach based on the integrated application of the standards.

Author Keywords: integration of management systems (IMS) in IT company
systems modeling (system modeling) and system method

articleTitle: The Problems of Quality Management Automation in Retail Sales
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The scientific sphere of retail sales using automated technical systems named vending machines is considered. The main problems of automation of quality management in such systems are researched. The description of the existing methods of automation of quality management is given. Possible scenarios for the development of automation systems are proposed. Recommendations for the automation of sales quality management through vending machines were formed. The assessment of state of devices and software market for vending companies is conducted. The main prospects of automation of quality management in the field of retail sales with using vending machines are defined.

articleTitle: Method of the GPS Tracking Analysis for Extraction of Geometrical Properties
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Moscow as a huge metropolis is characterized by its intense traffic and congestion of the transport network, despite the measures taken by regulators lately, as evidenced by the statistics of the INRIX company. On the characteristics of the flow significantly affects the behavior of drivers. Dangerous behavior while driving is a complicated psychological phenomenon from the point of identification and requires the development of a mechanism of its detection, as it was limited by Russian law in 2016. Modern information and communication technologies allow us to collect data of a vehicle motion in traffic based on a client-server system of GPS tracks. A method of processing of the GPS track is presented to separate it into sections with uniform traffic conditions. The method is allowing to use the automatic processing of large data flow, cleaning of the fragments, when the vehicle moves out of the traffic stream and can not be applied to the type of dangerous driving.

Author Keywords: risk taking and aggressive driving behavior

articleTitle: Quantity Measures of Quality in Higher Education in Russia. How Information Technologies Can Help?
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to several issues in modern higher education in Russia and its quality. In the study were found some indicators, including humanitarian, mathematic and natural scientific literacy, and interconnection between education programs and labor market need, which improving will lead to quality of higher education increase. Information technologies can help to collect and provide up to day data, that are important for quality, especially in TQM concept. Nevertheless, information technologies have to improve data accuracy and comparability. As a result, different types of literacy can be measured in dynamics and analyzed with Big Data technologies. Such quantity measures can help to improve higher education quality and provide individual recommendations for student educational track.

articleTitle: Additional Education in Russia. Ways of Development
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to issues in modern additional education in Russia. Three types of additional educational are analyzed: formal, informal and self-education. In the study are investigated percent of people, which are involved in additional education in Russia in the age 25-64 years in comparison with other OECD countries. Different information technologies for additional education are analyzed, including distance learning, e-learning and MOOCs. In the paper the main issues of information technologies for additional education in Russia are formulated. The result of the paper is several ideas about improvement of these technologies usage. The ideas based on technological development and implementation, and on current issues about their usage for additional education.

articleTitle: Formation of Innovative Mechanism of Staff Training in the Conditions of Digital Transformation of Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the digital economy, the necessity arises for new highly professional work force with digital skills and competence in the technology and communication field. The directions of increase of computer productivity in the context of economic sectors of the region, in particular adjustment and creation of new educational programs of skills training, formation of a complex system of independent assessment of qualification in the ICT sphere are defined. The mechanism of training senior staff in the conditions of digital transformation of economy, based on the formation of personal development pathways, the use of independent certification of competence and the establishment of integration links between universities, specialized secondary schools, major enterprises and public administration in the region, is defined.

articleTitle: Simulation of Thermoset Heat Conductivity by Means of Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study is relevant due to necessity of improvement of thermal and physical features of composite materials for ensuring the size stability of composite structures. Therefore, this Article is aimed at developing an automatized system for determining the thermal conductivity of thermosetting polymers by modified nanosized carbon structures depending on the process parameters. Since this is a multiple-parameter task lacking formalized solution methods which could ensure a high performance capability and fair accuracy, the method of simulation by means of artificial neural networks was used. This Article describes the procedure of manufacture and research of thermal conductivity of specimens of nano-modified binder. Upon the experimental research results, databases of thermal and physical features and manufacture process parameters of thermosetting polymers were formed what enabled the formation of a neural network model of dependence of thermal and physical features of thermosetting polymers modified with nanosized carbon structures from the manufacture process parameters. The elaborated neural model of dependence of thermal and physical features of thermosetting polymers modified with nanosized carbon structures ensures the total convergence of the obtained values for samples of the tuition, validation and testing -98.77%.

articleTitle: Reliability and Fault-tolerance Control of Automation Systems on Maritime Vessels
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The modern development of information technologies, using new generations of computer technology, computer networks, satellite communication systems, the latest achievements of measuring technology, creates prerequisites for the implementation of information processes of technical operation of ship power plants (SPM) at a qualitatively new level. Transport is one of the key branches of the economy, combining trade-industrial, communicative, recreational and other functions and influencing all spheres of socio-economic activity in the Russian Federation. Traditionally, sea and river transport is of great importance for Russia. It is represented by the courts of state, joint-stock and private shipping companies, coastal enterprises, including sea, river ports, shipyards, shipyards.

articleTitle: Usage of Information Technologies in Self-Education in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to self-education issues. Modern technologies spread self-education opportunities in many ways. Some of them are not obvious. For instance, such Internet services as VKontakte provides opportunities for including group interactions and discussions into self-education in Russia. Informational technologies improve self-education all over the world. In Russia, there is plenty of different types resources that provides instant access to educational information and abilities for direct communications between lecturers and students. As a result, self-education becomes easily, more affordable and accessible. However, there are still several key issues. The first of them is educational content quality estimation which becomes difficult due to plenty of educational resources. The second issue is shift from information studying to consumption.

articleTitle: Non-contact Respiratory Monitoring of Subjects with Sleep-Disordered Breathing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Long-term sleep monitoring might be helpful for biological, somnological and pharmaceutical studies. One of the most important task in this field is automated sleep structure estimation. As was shown in recent studies, it is possible to detect sleep stages of healthy subjects based on the analysis of respiratory patterns. However, it is still a question whether it is achievable for other cohorts. This paper presents an algorithm for breathing cycle detection on non-contact bioradiolocation signals for subjects with sleep-disordered breathing (SDB), which is the first step in the development of a technology for continuous sleep monitoring for the SDB population. The quality of the proposed algorithm was estimated based on comparison with a standard contact respiratory sensor. Our results contribute to extension of non-contact sleep monitoring technology.

articleTitle: Study of Digitization of Russian Higher Education as Basis for Smart Education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The research objective is to assess the status of digitalization of Russian higher education as a basis for the development of smart education. To solve the tasks of public administration of education, various state information systems are being created. 80% of Russian universities use different information systems in the administrative activities of universities. The assessments of the use of ICT in the educational process point to a great potential that has remained unoccupied in the last few years, less than 30% of Russian students are trained using e-learning and distance education technologies. The use of educational technologies and techniques using ICT is fragmentary. The initiative to develop educational tools and techniques on the basis of ICT, as a rule, belongs to nongovernmental organizations that highly appreciate not only the effectiveness of the use of these technologies in the educational process, but also the potential of the market of educational services provided online. The study shows that the Russian education system has created the necessary backlog for the creation of an ICT infrastructure, regulatory and legal support, which should be used to develop smart education.

articleTitle: Digital Technology in Ensuring the Safety of Food Services in the Hospitality Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The Creation of integrated information systems based on the methodology of HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) is an important urgent task, not only food industry but also the food security of the country. The system based on the principles of HACCP in the hospitality industry should provide for systematic monitoring of the state of products and processes at all stages of the life cycle production (manufacturing), storage, transportation (transportation), sale and disposal of food products.

articleTitle: Reliability of Space Infocommunications Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The theme of this work is the process of creating modern on-board space radio electronic equipment (REE), which performs the functions of infocommunications relations in television, Internet, navigation, telemetry, monitoring of terrestrial processes and others. With the increase in space expeditions to distant planets, the role of infocommunications technology is growing, and it must be provided by REE with high reliability. The peculiarity is that the increased terms of active existence of REE in these cases should be provided in an increased range of external factors. The author developed the information technology of computer modeling at the early stages of the design of space REE. At the same time, his scientific school created an automated system to ensure reliability and quality of equipment (ASONIKA). The work reveals the capabilities of the ASONIKA system for the convergence of the existing theory of reliability in order to ensure trouble-free infocommunications technology for long space flights.

articleTitle: Management of Technological Development of Enterprises on the Basis of a Life Cycle Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The interrelation of the directions of technological development of the industrial enterprises with efficiency of the used resources - material, labor and physical capital in the form of fixed assets is shown. The sequence of transition from one direction to another characterizing the life cycle of technological development is considered. A graphical model of such a cycle, including six stages, is presented. It is determined that the change of each stage of development of the value of one of the three indicators (material efficiency, capital productivity or coefficient of technological level of production) begins to change in the opposite direction. A practical method of calculating the time moment showing the completion of each individual stage is developed. It is shown how the transition from one stage to another affects the change in the cost of production of enterprises. The optimal time of change of production technology or its improvement is determined. It was found that the new technology for further improvement of production efficiency should provide the necessary level of capital productivity, and a method of calculating this level.

Author Keywords: stages of the life cycle of technologies
coefficient of technological level of production

articleTitle: Internal Education Quality Assurance through Standardization of Educational Organization Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The approaches used by educational organizations for internal education quality assurance are described. Approach to internal education quality assurance - standardization of quality management systems of educational organizations is offered. The structure and the principles of the new international standard ISO 21001:2018 containing requirements and guidance to the creation of management systems in educational organizations are described. Use of ISO 21001:2018 as a tool of internal education quality assurance is offered.

articleTitle: The Technical Diagnostics of Electronic Schema on the Base of the Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of research is the electronic schema, which consists of elements. The subject of research is the reliability of the electronic schema. The tool used for research is artificial neural network. The goal is to reduce expenses on the artificial neural network training. The problems are: the big amount of manual labor on training examples and expenses of time for neural network training. The neural network was used for technical diagnostics of the electronic schema. The artificial neural network must be trained. Training of an artificial neural network requires the training examples, computing resources, time of training. The new switches architecture of the electronic schema was proposed. In article is developed the new way of training of the artificial neural network used the mathematical models of elements in the electronic schema with switchers architecture.

articleTitle: The Concept of Construction Modularity of Control Programs for CNC Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: After the examination of major features of fast-managed enterprises we mark its equipment requirements and display the forms of interaction of flexible production elements. Moreover, we built a table of technical requirements for design documentation which forms the operational designations for technological transitions while various degrees of complexity products manufacturing. We studied the forms of interactions in control programs composition using design and technological elements ranking and marked further task to study this programming method in operational activity process.

articleTitle: Attraction and Retention of Women in Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: With the advance of digital society it is imperative to attract and retain women specialists in engineering. To identify gender patterns of career choice in Russia and the problems Russian women specialists face while adapting to work environments in STEM, we conducted a series of expert interviews with young women engineers in the spring of 2018 and compared the data with the results of the 2013-2014 studies. We came to the conclusion that although some of the professional gender-related stereotypes still persist, they also undergo active transformation. Women's success in undergraduate STEM education makes them feel more empowered to continue their post-graduate studies and to pursue careers in engineering. We also found that the current policy of attracting more women to the field of engineering, high-tech industries and innovation has had a certain effect on women's choice of profession and career plans. The results of our research can be used for designing more gender balanced personnel policies and strategies to help women overcome structural barriers in their professional development and career advancement in STEM.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Development of E-Learning in Russia and Information Society
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to development of e-learning in Russia. Russia has its own domestic MOOC platforms and social networks, there are e-learning universities and programs, thus level of inclusion into information society is rather high. E-learning is developed in three ways: courses, programs and distance universities. The most important issue in this development is standardization and quality. Whereas regular universities and MOOC platforms have their own of government standards of education, many independent organizations have not. Therefore, distance universities are a kind of middle variant. These universities have government accreditation, but all or vast majority of their educational activities are realized via Internet that provides flexibility to this kind of education. Moreover, development of social networks and their usage influence on e-learning development and involvement into lifelong education.

articleTitle: Eliminating Transport Losses with the Aid of Intelligent Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper dwells upon lean technologies in urban transport. It is assumed that using digital technologies can help to eliminate losses in the urban transportation system. A possible scheme for the use of digital technologies for the rapid solution of problems in urban transport is offered.

articleTitle: Separate Aspects of Smart Cities Security
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of smart cities is not without risk. Services that use digital data are completely dependent on the security and integrity of this data. That is why city planners and city administrations need to prepare for digital accidents in the same way as for natural disasters. In today's rapidly changing environment, information security is becoming a key element in the strategy for creating smart cities from the very beginning. When creating cities, there is always the task of protecting the critical infrastructure and the means of controlling it physically. Similarly, it is necessary to ensure the security of the digital infrastructure. The basic principles of constructing digital protection for a smart city include: device discovery and access control, ensuring data integrity, intelligent network segmentation and threat prevention.

articleTitle: Digitalisation of Public Relations Practice as an Issue to Meet Employers’ Needs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Higher Education system is under reorganization in the modern day Russia. Education quality, the use of computer technologies, innovative approaches and cooperation with employers are the key priorities of this reformation. The experience of ETU "LETI" PR Study Departments (School of Humanities) employers demands monitoring in the field of Public Relations and Advertising and the main tendencies, results of it are represented in the article.

articleTitle: State-private Partnership as Tool for Achieving Strategic Objectives in Sphere of Maritime Transport and Logistics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The complexity, unity and inseparability of the system of the state's sea use, both from the functional and regional points of view, are manifested in the effect of adjustments to any of the directions of maritime policy, the vector of which is presented in the doctrinal document of Russia - the Maritime Doctrine of the Russian Federation until 2020 and its draft up to 2030.

articleTitle: Vibration Control of the State of Electrical Contact Connections and Quality of Products and Systems Containing them
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Changes in the states of electrical contact compounds arising during the operation of products and systems containing them, as well as those related to manufacturing and manufacturing technologies, are considered. For the pressure contact connections, the relationship between the parameters of their state is determined. Questions of vibrodiagnostics of the considered states changes are discussed.

articleTitle: The Knowledge Management System Development for Smart Education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper is devoted to solving a problem of improving the content of education and instructional materials used. The digital technologies are developing so fast that the engineering aspects of application and scientific investigations start blurring the aspects associated with the methodology and content of smart learning. The need for development of digital economy places severe requirements not only upon know-how, but also upon the content of smart learning, i.e., the content of educational courses shall be a reflection of professional activity. The techniques and methods of knowledge management can provide for a desired rate and quality of development of educational materials. This paper describes a knowledge management system which employs intelligent database, network and co-authorship instruments to insure the compliance of the content being developed with the requirements of digital economy and fills out the smart learning with a qualitative content.

articleTitle: Synergysm of the Open Education System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers students' attitude towards the system of open education and the directions of its development in the near future from the standpoint of changing pedagogical views. Distinctive feature of the article is the use of nonlinear dynamics principles for understanding the directions of open education system development. That allows to define new development paths taking into account the forms of development of youth people Internet socialization.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Calculation the Morbidity Rate in the Metropolis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: According to the infection spread modern megacities are very dangerous environment. One of the critical factor is population density. In addition, there are number of criteria that affect the morbidity rate. To prevent the danger, a special automated system is required, which allow to calculate the infection spread rate. Important feature of the designed system is applying of the complex approach for the most accurate calculation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment of the Prospects for the Medical Industry Development in Russia under Conditions of Import Substitution
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis and evaluation of the perspectives of the medical industry development in Russia in the condition of import substitution. The article considers modern methods and approaches for the prevention and treatment of bronchopulmonary diseases, including in young children. The main restrictions on their introduction into Russia were revealed.

articleTitle: Specifics of Management Quality Implementation to Information Systems and Products
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Quality management implementation is quite different in many spheres. In the paper, specifics of its implementation to information systems and products are observed, as well as in companies that produce them. Undoubtedly, TQM is one of the most popular and applicable concepts in sphere of production. While its implementation is quite different even in leading companies in one sphere. In the paper, Google and Apple practices are observed. Moreover, some elements of this concept are specified. Among them are quantitative indicators of quality, benchmarking, customers learning, corrective actions, goals of the product development, suppliers pooling, statistical thinking and teamwork. Nevertheless, the most important issue about quality management in informational systems is personal competences and development, that is one of TQM elements and the one that determines product quality.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Rendering of Texts in iOS Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to new asynchronous methods for rendering text information in mobile applications for iOS operating system.

articleTitle: Information Technologies at the Choice of an Optimum Bank Protection Structures for Highways in Emergency Situations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The theory and technique of creation of imitating system for the choice of an optimal variant of bank protection constructions (BPC) along highways in mountain territories considering hydrological, hydraulic and morphological conditions of the rivers are offered. For the research twenty options of BPC which are widely used on the rivers of the North Caucasus among which thirteen constructions are patented by us in the Russian Federation have been presented.

articleTitle: Prosodic Processing for the Automatic Synthesis of Emotional Russian Speech
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the automatic speech synthesis technology is undergoing significant changes due to new solutions in the field of machine learning. These solutions qualitatively improve the sound of synthesized speech, bringing it closer to natural human speech. Against the backdrop of this, as well as under the influence of business, the development of artificial emotional speech for human-machine interaction systems has received a new strong turn of development. Due to this prosodic processing for the synthesis of Russian emotional speech has become an important research direction for our research group.The article presents an algorithm for predicting pause locations for three categories of emotional speech. In particular, the authors used three corpora of emotional speech, collected according to emotional categories (neutral, excited and depressed), for training classifiers. The obtained results can be used to create a high-quality automatic synthesizer of emotional speech.

articleTitle: Method of Calculation of the Main Cutting Edge Form for Turn-Milling Profile
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The work is devoted to definition of the angled tool for processing of external surfaces by turn-milling method. The advantage of this processing method is shown. The calculation formulas for radius of curvature of the cutting edge for turn-milling are presented.

articleTitle: Management of the System for Russian Arctic Region Logistics and Information Support
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article explores the problem of the creation and development of a logistics system in the Arctic, which is to ensure the implementation of key management functions related to ensuring the safety of the main control processes: production, transportation, processing, packaging and delivery of the products to the consumer.

articleTitle: Development of Web-environment for Communication Between Master’s Degree Students on Research and Innovation Issues
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers actual problems of the Internet environment development for master's degree students. Results of the analysis of university portals and social networks regarding their relevance for organization of research and innovative activity of master's degree students are cited. The authors conclude that it is necessary to create a special Internet environment for this category of trainees. The structure and implementation of the environment are justified.

articleTitle: Piloting of the Integrated Model for Quality Assurance in Education QM&CQAF in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the piloting of the integrated quality assurance model for education QM&CQAF in Russia as well as the guidelines on the model application. The model was developed within the framework of the project "The expansion of the EU approaches to providing the partner countries higher education quality assurance": Expanding Quality assurance (QM&CQAF) (Project number: 565454-EPP-1-2015-1-HREPPJMO-NETWORK).

articleTitle: Professional Standards in Engineering Education and Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of information and communication technologies in the fourth industrial revolution can provide new educational opportunities, so it requires for more qualified graduates. The quality control of education is mostly investigated so far. It is caused by current professional standards that cover some necessary criteria for graduates at all levels. The paper observes current educational trends, suggests proper methods to put an integrated approach in practice and results of their application. So, 01.03.02 Applied mathematics and Computer science is an example of major.

articleTitle: To Problems of Qualimetric Estimation of Quality in Education and Science
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of a number of poorly-studied methodological problems of the application of qualimetric methods in order to manage the quality of activities and products of activity in key social spheres-education and science. It noted the existence of real laws restricting the ability of qualimetric methods in social management. At the same time, it is shown that the key to solving a whole range of problems of the development of education and science (competence approach, regulation and self-regulation of scientific activity) lies in the further development of qualimetric methods oriented to these spheres.

articleTitle: Applying Maple Computing Environment in Teaching Mathematics to University Students Majoring in Technical
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article shares the experience of using Maple computer algebra system in teaching mathematics to students majoring in technical studies. Universities need to change classical teaching methods to educate top graduates properly to get knowledge accumulated by mankind and modern technologies. Further mathematics course to engineering students should be focused on the applied approach to master mathematical apparatus, not computing technique. This approach teaches future engineers to use that skill to solve their job tasks. The authors have used Maple computing environment in teaching mathematics for several years. This graphic system can produce curve and surfaces graphics specified in different coordinate systems quickly and accurately. The animation of basic mathematical notions help learners succeed in course without sticking to complex computations. Visualized mathematical knowledge via Maple allows improving education. It motivates to acquire knowledge and trains better professionals. The experiment increased qualitative academic performance by 16,9% in the experimental group.

articleTitle: Modeling the Optimal Format of Strategic Management of a Company for Establishing a Region’s Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This research involves modeling and simulating a business process of strategic management of a food company in order to achieve a region's sustainable development. This business process is seen as an optimal format of strategic management. The Modeling and simulation conducted in this research is implemented in the Adonis: CE software.

articleTitle: Mobile Operating Systems and Integrated Apps Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are huge changes at the mobile operating systems market due to new restrictions by USA. Chinese companies need to create and develop their own mobile operating systems, in case if they want to continue production of mobile phones. As a result, issue about mobile operating systems and integrated apps quality and quality management is important. In the paper, structure of this management system is assumed. The system includes TQM principles and technological parts of the quality management. Four key parts of technical quality of mobile operating systems are presented. Each of them is specified. Moreover, the most important aspect for future development of mobile operating systems quality are specified.

articleTitle: Directions for the Development of Wine Tasting Tourism in the South of Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Enological (wine) tourism is a subspecies of gastronomic tourism. The main purpose of wine tourism is to visit the enterprise of the wine-growing and winemaking industry: a vineyard, a separate winery or a wine farm with various purposes.The model of excursion wine tourism stands out among other models, since it is universal. It includes visits to wineries, acquaintance with nature, historical and artistic heritage, and even active rest. This model is widespread in all countries of the world where wine-making is developed.A special case of the excursion model of wine tourism is special-themed (tasting), which means acquaintance of wine tourists with specific types, styles, samples of wines. The organization of special-themed wine tourism is quite complicated because of the variety of types of wines, often it requires the participation of a specialist with a special education.

articleTitle: Concrete Macrostructure Modelling – as a Method of Increasing the Quality of Transport Facilities Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Increasing the effectiveness of construction production quality management, reducing the cost, technological processes labor intensity and a number of other topical tasks in transport objects construction are inextricably linked with the usage and development of progressive building materials and their testing for the usage in certain conditions, under various loads. An imitating model of concrete is proposed in the form of a two-component system consisting of a matrix and inclusions -porous aggregate grains simulated by convex polygons. On their border there is a zone of contact with properties other than the matrix and inclusions, and in the bulk of the material (in the matrix and inclusions), initial defects of the pore structure of various shapes and sizes are randomly located. Unlike concrete on porous aggregates in heavy concrete, the defectiveness of the macrostructure is due to the violation of the contact of granite rubble with the matrix.

articleTitle: Information Analysis and Synthesis of Organizational Structure of the Unique Project
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the problems of analysis and synthesis of the organizational structure of unique projects, the Information Theory is used. The modeling of the organizational structure was carried out at the most abstract level. A technique for optimizing the organizational structure is proposed, taking into account the principle of information value of management system resources. Information indicators of the effectiveness of the management system are formalized.

articleTitle: Perspectives for Smart City Technologies in the Resort Region
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the methodological and practical foundations of the constituent relationships in the tourist destination. Intellectual technologies cover almost all aspects of life these days, although they are often taken for granted. The tourism industry has become one of the most active entities using the latest IT technologies in order to increase the volume and quality of services provided, and to increase its efficiency. The key elements of the relationship are defined in accordance with the concept of smart tourism at the regional level. Analysis, comparison and synthesis of the most effective mechanisms of regional relationships that form a complex of smart tourism have made it possible to identify key aspects of the communication core of a smart destination.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Mining of Ethereum Cryptocurrency
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Cryptocurrency mining is an important process that ensures the reliability of cryptocurrency system. A significant computing power is used in cryptocurrency mining. One of the most important tasks in cryptocurrency mining is to ensure the maximum performance of used computing capacities. In this paper we review the existing Ethereum mining algorithm and search for possibilities for speeding up the mining by applying a new asynchronous mining algorithm.

articleTitle: Towards Simulation of the Processes Related to Transport Movement within Industrial Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to modeling the processes associated with movement of the vehicles at production facilities. The authors define main tasks that have to be solved when modeling each particular process. A model of spatio-temporal and other essential characteristics of movement is described. The model proposed considers that the movement of the vehicle is monitored by different monitoring devices such as access control checkpoints, video cameras and weight measuring devices. The software implementation of the generator of movement logs has been developed. The tasks for the future research are defined.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Thermal and Electrical Processes in Electronic Units with the Account of Random Variances of Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents a technique for investigating the electrical and thermal processes occurring in the receiving-computational units for unmanned aerial vehicles. A special feature of the technique is the consideration of random variance of technological parameters of materials and electrical parameters of electronic components. This technique provides for mutual phased electric modeling using SPICE models and thermal modeling using the subsystems ASONIKA-T (for the block study) and ASONIKA-TM (for studying separately each printed circuit assembly). As an example, the original data for the real receiver-computing unit are taken.

articleTitle: Social Capital of Professors as a Factor of Increasing the Effectiveness of the University
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Possible approaches to building the conceptual and mathematical models to the measurement of social capital of the University are discussed in this paper. We characterize the structure of social capital, determine the factors affecting the level of social capital, identify indicators of its estimation, formulate the problem of predict the effectiveness of the University through the organization of measurement by these indicators. The problems associated with the measurement of social capital are described. Discusses the choice of the mathematical model of the organization of estimation of social capital in the context of determining the confidence interval of the permissible values of the effectiveness of the University as a basis for making management decisions. Examines the complexity of the task of estimation of social capital at the University, posit that the decision these problems by standard methods is very difficult. For the solution of this task offers to use the method of sign-perturbed sums (SPS). This paper develops the previous ideas of the authors on the use of randomized algorithms in socio-humanitarian researches, in which the traditional assumptions about of stochastic character, independence and the symmetry of noise of the observations are often made unreasonably.

Author Keywords: evaluate of social capital and effectiveness of the University
conceptual and mathematical models of social capital

articleTitle: Classification of Methods of Reverse Engineering in the Configuration Management of Original High-Tech Radio Electronic Products
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article contains classification of modern methods of reverse-engineering high-tech radio electronic production for the levels of constructor hierarchy. That is shown that while managing risks on the stages of the high-tech radio electronic production life cycle an important place remains to the intellectual property-related risks. Both well-known and new methods of technical protection from copying original radio electronic production are represented.

articleTitle: About Import Substitution in the Field of Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The implementation of the policy of import substitution in the field of information technology in Russia is being considered. The review of the information technology market before the start of import substitution is given. The implementation activities are outlined strategy of import substitution. The characteristic of the import substitution plan for the period from 2015 to 2025 is presented. The first results of import substitution in the field of information technologies are stated.

articleTitle: Research of Environmental Problems of Roadside Territories and Some Innovative Technologies of their Solution
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In mountain territories, most often, the unique place of the building of highways is floodplains of the rivers. The mountain rivers during the flood periods, often wash away coastal fastenings and destroy roads as a result of side water erosion. Innovative developments on strengthening of coast of the rivers are offered.

articleTitle: The Investigation of Machine Learning Methods in the Problem of Automation of the Sales Management Business-process
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Methods of machine learning in the application to the task of managing sales in retail trade are considered. The features of the sales management process and the nuances of applying the methods of machine learning are noted. The advantages of using machine learning methods are highlighted. Attention is focused on the risks in the application of methods of machine learning. Practical methods of machine learning "without a teacher" are considered in practice. The quality of the results of the applied methods is estimated using various quality metrics. As a result, it was found that reducing the dimension of the feature space does not lead to loss of information, but helps reduce the load on the computing system.

articleTitle: Technologies in Cryomedicine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed work is devoted to the study of the boundary value problem with free boundaries, which describes the dynamics of the temperature field in the destruction of tissues by spherical and hemispherical applicators using information and communication technologies. Information and communication technologies were used in the work to solve a one-dimensional problem with a free boundary.

articleTitle: Subsystem On-Board Information-Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The necessity of development of the system of monitoring of the railway track and the adjacent territory with the use of geoinformation systems is substantiated. The structure of the information-measuring system is given. Describes how to implement a split plot treatment of the locomotive on linear areas and parts of the analysis. The composition of the measuring system to solve the problem of rail track diagnostics is considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Students Self-education Forms Abroad for the Professional Mobility Formation Using IT-technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the relevance of self-education process to form the future specialists' professional mobility. In the publication the basic forms of the self-education organization are presented in the universities of Germany, the US, Britain, France, Norway, Poland and other countries. The principles and functions of the self-education organization are defined in some universities abroad. The students' self-education organization forms contribute to the qualities formation at the basis of the future specialists' professional mobility.

articleTitle: Building Recommender System for Media with High Content Update Rate
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A wide variety of recommender systems have been deployed on different media websites. Nonetheless, providing personalized recommendations for hundreds of new users and articles appearing daily still appears to be a challenge. In this paper, we propose a method for generating personalized recommendations for media resources with high content creation rate. We explore two general approaches, gradient boosting model and matrix factorization algorithm. Preliminary experiments showed that gradient boosting performs better for our website in terms of training speed, resource consumption, and scalability.

articleTitle: E-learning Design Principles at the University
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article touches upon issues concerning e-learning design at the university. The approach to build e-education, which is related to the development of the IT infrastructure of the university, the business architecture and the process-service approach have been proposed. The business processes, services, IT infrastructure of the university providing e-learning have been considered.

articleTitle: Prospects of Use Gas Engines on Sea and River Vessels
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The state program "Introduction of gas-engine equipment on automobile, railway, sea, river, aviation transport and special-purpose equipment" includes the tasks of using gas-engine fuel in many sectors of the economy of the Russian Federation. In the Strategy of development of inland water transport of the Russian Federation for the period up to 2030 (the Order of the Government of the Russian Federation of February 29, 2016 N 327-p) development of scientifically proved offers and a complex of actions for transfer of power installations of vessels and coastal objects of inland water transport to work on gas motor fuel (liquefied or compressed) is provided. For the introduction of gas motor fuel in the fleet it is necessary to analyze the experience of the use of gas fuel in related sectors of transport and energy and foreign practice.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Surface Charge of Cylindrical Particles for Mechatronic Systems for Remote Monitoring of Complex Meteorological Formations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mechatronic monitoring systems based on radar systems are widely used for the study and monitoring of complex meteorological formations, which include various types of clouds. Clouds are a complex polydisperse system of particles of different shapes and sizes. To improve the accuracy of detection and recognition of cloud types, it is necessary to develop mathematical models that allow calculating the characteristics of electromagnetic wave scattering by particles of different shapes and sizes, taking into account various factors, in particular, the surface charge on cloud particles. The purpose of this article is to develop a mathematical model for calculating the attenuation, scattering and radar reflection coefficients of electromagnetic waves by cloud particles of cylindrical shape taking into account surface charges. It is shown that when the density of surface charges tends to zero, the obtained relations tend to the known formulas for neutral particles, and when the surface density of charges tends to infinity, they tend to the relations for perfectly conducting cylindrical particles.

articleTitle: Formation of the Electronic Educational Trajectory for Maritime Students
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, students have the opportunity to self-realization and build an individual educational trajectory, as well as provides methods of automated support for the learner in choosing it. Thus, there is an individual educational trajectory (variational learning). Theoretical aspects of the justification of the educational trajectory already exist, then it becomes necessary to develop its practical application in the learning process. The article considers the technology of formation of the electronic educational trajectory is considered when the e-learning system is used.

articleTitle: Internet - Socialization of Russian Youth
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers new forms of Internet socialization of the youth of Russia, as well as the application of these forms in distance learning technologies. The work analyzes the use of new forms of socialization in education system, the results are systematized in the form of a table. Materials can promote the implementation of new mechanisms of Internet socialization in the system of open education.

articleTitle: Investment Mechanisms to Improve the Sustainability of the Development of the Region by the Example of the Voronezh Region
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A conceptual approach is proposed to attract investment in the Voronezh Region, which is characterized by taking into account the characteristics of the region in the social, economic, geopolitical spheres of activity. An innovative concept for the development of the economic potential of the Voronezh Region on the basis of increasing the efficiency of the investment policy for the development of the social and economic potential of the region is proposed. The main principles and objectives of the investment policy are formulated, ways of solving problems related to attracting investments to the region are shown. The solutions found are indirectly verified using the experience of investment management at the state level.

articleTitle: The Formation of an Effective Model of the Creation of New Market of Transport Production Using Methods of the Calculus of Variations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the article it is proved the efficiency of the new markets creation of transport production at implementation of investment projects of railway lines' construction basing on the solution of optimizing problems of calculus of variations.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Technological Process of Pipe Bending with the Introduction of Digital Technologies and Information Security Requirements
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the technological process improvement by means of introduction of digital technologies and information security requirements. The purpose of the study was to analyze the increase in the competitiveness of machine-building enterprises through the use of information technologies on the example of the technological process of pipe bending. This article analyzes the technology of bending pipes, used equipment. The analysis of possible risks in the technological process of pipe bending from the point of view of information security was carried out.

articleTitle: Vibration Features in Hard Cutting of Harden Steel Workpiece
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article sets out the results of researches of vibration signals accompanying the process of ceramic cutters cutting in hardened surface. The paper reviews the effect of tool degradation and self-oscillations on stability of cutting process. The text examines the outcomes of experiments with thermal conductivity variation of tools.

articleTitle: Cellular Automata as Traffic Models and Spectrum of Two-Dimensional Contour Networks — Open Chainmails
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A concise review is given on applications of cellular automata as traffic models and new analytical results have been obtained for a discrete dynamical system. The concepts of a contour network and its spectrum have been introduced by A. P. Buslaev. Contours of the system form a regular two-dimensional rectangular structure, which is called open chainmail. The open chainmail is a Buslaev contour network. The spectrum of the system is studied.

articleTitle: The Finite Element of the Plate with the Account of the Transformation of the Cross Section and the Nonlinear Foundation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the article a method for simulating base support with allowance for transverse shear for use in finite element calculations is proposed, the basic matrix relations that allow calculating the plates taking into account the nonlinearity of the base rebuff are obtained.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Implemented Innovations Impact on Urban Passenger Transport Services Demand
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the research results of assessment of the implemented innovations impact on urban passenger transport services demand. The research and obtaining estimates methodology has been elaborated based on synthesis of expert assessment method and methods of econometric and statistical analysis. The obtained results allow to infer about planned and implemented innovations impact on urban passenger transport services demand.

Author Keywords: assessment of innovations impact on demand
demand for urban passenger transport services

articleTitle: Improvement of the Activities of Machine-Building Enterprises Through the Use of Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mechanical engineering is the leading branch of the country - creating tools, engineering largely influences the pace and direction of scientific and technological progress, the growth of labor productivity. The article analyzes the improvement of the activity of machine-building enterprises by using digital technologies at all stages of the product life cycle. It was revealed that the information is one of the most important resources of the enterprise, which must be protected by the introduction of the information security system.

articleTitle: New Scientific and Educational Competences of the Digital Economy of the Transport Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with new scientific and educational competences of technologies and tools set of the digital economy, that allow in cooperation with economic entities involved in the value chain of goods or services in transport the development of digitalization and harmonization of physical assets of production, system management of basic business processes, that fully realize the opportunities and a strategy for the development of the transport industry.

articleTitle: Study on Using Laboratory Model to Research for Bearing Capacity of Soft Ground Improved by Deep Cement Mixing Columns due to Embankment Load with Different Montmorillonite Contents
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The Mekong Delta is the largest delta of Vietnam, covered Holocence sediment due to sedimentation of the Mekong river system. The minerals of soft clay in this area usually include: Montmorillonite (MMT), Illite, Chlorite, and Kaolinite...MMT in clay affect to the soil swelling properties. The developed swelling pressure will destroy the lightly construction and road surface. This research simulated the influence of MMT to the bearing capacity of soft ground improved by deep cement mixing (CDM) columns by laboratory model. To conduct this research, the laboratory model 1g has been studied and made. The different of MMT contents is changed from 6% to 15% for soft ground to research the changes to strength of soft ground improved by CDM columns. In addition, this research also investigates the optimum cement content to unconfined compressive strength of the soil cement specimen with the different MMT contents. Soft ground improved by deep cement mixing may be used for foundation of the immersed tunnels.

articleTitle: Operation of Civil and Linear Facilities of Railway Transport in Arctic Zone
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of materials on the deformation of civil, industrial and linear structures of railway transport located in the Arctic zone. The results obtained allow us to predict permafrost condition of the subsoil of railway infrastructure facilities, and develop measures on its stabilization.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Safety of Maritime Transportation of Energy Resources in Difficult Regions of the Arctic
