publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Estimation of reserves and potential resources of oil and gas, as well as the possibility of energy resources development in difficult arctic conditions. The spatial organization of rational structure of sea transportation of these resources in the Arctic is substantiated on condition that the icebreaker support is provided.

articleTitle: Calculation Methods for Assessing the Reliability of Ship Hulls
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The reliability of the hull is the most important factor of its safe and trouble-free operation. To assess the impact of service life on the reliability of the body can be effectively used calculation methods presented in the article. The described methods are based on the requirements and definitions established by the Rules of Russian classification societies. The article proposes a probabilistic model of failures of ship hull elements due to wear after a given number of years of operation. On the basis of such a model, it is possible to predict the volume of repair of the body, taking into account previously performed repairs; accepted methods of repair, on the basis of this fault detection; duration and conditions of long-term operation.

articleTitle: Application of CAE for Modeling the Parametric Failure of the Spindle Due to Rigidity by Bearing Wear
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the technique of modeling spindles of machines for estimating bearing wear and forecast endurance.

articleTitle: Company Life Cycle and Quality Standardization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are many life cycle theories. In the paper, the model of five stages is presented. Each stage is specified throughout business functions and standardization. For each stage the main processes were observed. Moreover, main project management methods were specified via standardization that uses in each of them. In the result of the paper associations between life cycle stages, key methods of project management for each of them and standardization were provided. Standardization in this context supposed as standardization of internal or external business processes in the company. For each life cycle stage, there are its own standardization process.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Strategic Decision-Making in TQM Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes Intelligent system for strategic decision-making in TQM systems. Tools of decision-making theory are consistently brought in line with group methods and are designed for different types of tasks. However, the wide availability (including among inexperienced users) generates a problem of selecting an optimal set of mathematical methods and software tools for the implementation of an integrated intelligent decision support system (hereinafter-DSS).

articleTitle: Development of Lattice Design for Increasing the Energy Efficiency of the Grinding Process of Food Products
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes a useful model that relates to the elements of the cutting mechanism of a shredder of technological raw materials for the production of food products and can be used both in the food industry and in domestic conditions.

articleTitle: Modeling of Effeciency Assessment for Enterprises Economic Activity in Environmental System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the consideration of an issue of efficiency assessment for enterprises economic activity. the analyze of scientific views of different authors to the problem of enterprises economic efficiency assessment in environmental system is done. The coefficient of environmental management quality based on Delphi technique is developed. The authors propose a new assessment indicator of ecologic and economic efficiency of enterprises activity in environmental system, also, it is tested on a particular example.

Author Keywords: indicator of ecological and economic effeciency assessment

articleTitle: The Influence of Design Features on the Electrical Characteristics of the Microwave Volumetric Strip-Slot Line Transition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper studies an impact of various structure elements of the microwave volumetric strip-slot line transition on its electrical performance. The analysis has been carried out using numerical modeling methods. The results of the calculations, presented in the form of elements of the scattering matrix, allow us to draw conclusions about the permissible packing density of the beamformer elements near the microwave volumetric strip-slot line transition, and also to determine its most critical zones in which the location of the line elements strongly affects the transition characteristics. Based on the study, the possibility of using the microwave volumetric strip-slot line transition in multilayer microwave devices with a high packing density of the elements in the line is confirmed.

articleTitle: Project Financing in the Interaction of Regional and Municipal Authorities and Business Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the existing forms of cooperation between public and private partners through the creation of new organizational associations whose aim is the implementation of joint investment projects - specialized companies of project financing and joint ventures, reveales the necessary conditions for the application of these mechanisms, depending on the amount of available financial resources of the project participants. It considers the mechanism of participation of public partners in specialized companies of project participation.

articleTitle: Problems of Criteria Analysis and Interpretation in Automated Systems for Assessing Scientific and Technical Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the main problems in the analysis of criteria and their interpretation in automated systems for assessing scientific and technical solutions and describes the human factor influence on their results. The paper presents an example of implementing the criteria informativeness analysis in the automated system for evaluating the efficiency of scientific and technical solutions developed by the authors. An analysis of the informativeness of the selected criteria was carried out and the accuracy of pattern recognition was determined in the context of real scientific and technical decisions in the field of electric power industry based on the data of grant applications.

articleTitle: The Implementation of the Innovation Platform "Educational Potential of Hardware-Software Complexes Based on the Study and Interpretation of Brain Activity Patterns"
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the main objectives and features of realization of the innovation platform "Educational potential of hardware-software complexes based on the study and interpretation of brain activity patterns". Standard volumetric test is used in order to obtain objective data about the characteristics of the child for building individual learning paths. The prototype of the brain-computer system will be tested in the course of the innovation platform. It will allow to assess the condition of children in the learning process based on the analysis of brain signals. The regional innovation platform was established on the basis of the Yuri Gagarin SSTU, lecturers of N.G. Chernyshevsky SSU are working on pedagogical fundamentals and methods of application of this technology. Cooperation is necessary because such developments should be created in accordance with pedagogical and ergonomic requirements for information systems providing automation of information and methodological support of the educational process.

articleTitle: Analytical Description of Materials Deformation Diagrams for the Calculation of Reinforced Concrete Elements with Combined Prestress
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article offers an analytical description of the complete deformation diagrams of materials used in the development of the methodology for calculating reinforced concrete bending elements with combined prestressing.

articleTitle: Mathematical Autotransformer Modeling in Technical Means of Education and Modern Education Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper shows that currently existing mathematical autotransformer models do not provide a detailed representation of physical processes occurring in the transformer in its operating mode. Main operating modes are considered and analyzed, a universal system of equations for a two-winding step-down autotransformer, taking into account the classical representation of the physical processes of its operation, are established. A vector diagram valid from the point of view of physics is constructed.

articleTitle: Automated Monitoring System for the Technical Condition of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the security system for monitoring buildings and structures, an analysis of the measures in the course of operation of the facility.

articleTitle: Modeling & Selection of the Road Construction Company Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the current system of road construction, the actual task is to choose the model of the road construction company correctly, as well as to establish the methodology for processing the results of modeling to identify its (company) production structures. The Pareto optimality principle is to be considered.

articleTitle: Aspects of Simulation of Advertising Campaign in the Hotel-Tourist Sphere
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The most important task is to optimize the advertising process.In the tourist-recreational sphere, this problem is more acute than in many other sectors of the economy. In practice, even if the total amount of the advertising budget is determined, the key issue remains its optimal distribution by various media.The priority indicator in this case is the attitude of the target audience to the whole audience both in terms of the specialization of advertised hotel and tourist services and in terms of the territorial distribution of the services provided.Mathematical modeling of the processes of building and implementing an advertising campaign allows us to clarify the characteristics of each of the selected options for its conduct.

articleTitle: Efficiency of the Linear Geotechnical Structures Intense Construction Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Intense construction technology was developed in IPSS MIIT for weak foundations of geotechnical structures strengthening and consolidation speeding up during the construction period. The experience of intense regimes application in PVT Transstroymechanizatsia has shown the draught acceleration during the construction and shortening of the subgrade construction. Let us show that theseadvantages allow gaining the technological and economic positive effect.

articleTitle: Development of the Concept of the Predictive Model of Freight Cars Transportation in the Planned Repair
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the concept of predictive model of freight cars transportation in the planned repair at the site of the Moscow railway. As methods of research the statistical processing and analysis of data of the executed runs of freight cars for the ten-year period is used. The result of the study is the development of the concept of predictive model of transportation of freight cars in the planned repair. The conceptual model is the basis for the creation of a mathematical model of forecasting the effective distribution of freight cars in the planned repair.

articleTitle: Business Trends and Opportunities of South Korea and India Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article explores the economical profile of South Korea and India, analyses the trade and investment relations and explores future areas of potential co-operation between India and Korea. Authors discover that the rise in merchandise trade between the two countries has been in the main owing to the ever-changing demand structure and comparative benefits of each the economies in complementary sectors in recent years.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Smart Contracts in a Decentralized Health Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today digitalization penetrates into all spheres of human activity. The volume of digital data is increasing. Therefore, it is necessary to use innovative methods of information processing. This is important for the effective management of socio-economic systems. The urgent task is to ensure the security of storage of digital assets. System analysis of blockchain technology is carried out. The authors substantiate the effectiveness of the use of lockers for the safe storage and transmission of information. The advantages and prospects of implementation blockchain in the management of social and economic systems are presented. The purpose of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of blockchain in the health care system. The article presents a model of the decentralized infrastructure of the health care system. Interaction of participants within the model provides solutions to existing problems. The article presents the scheme of the distributed data register for creation of the electronic medical card of the patient. An algorithm for the use of smart contracts in the health care system has been developed. The results of the research prove the effectiveness of the blockade technology for storing records of electronic medical records of patients.

articleTitle: Enterprise’s Innovative Infrastructure Development Model Based on Quality Function Deployment Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The application of the QFD method for solving the problem of designing an innovative enterprise infrastructure is proposed. As requirements of the "consumer", the conditions for effective implementation of the company's innovation strategy are considered. Five alternative types of innovative strategies are identified. The requirements for each strategy to the level of development of the company's innovation infrastructure are determined. With the use of benchmarking technology and the expert assessments method, the matrix of the elements of the innovation infrastructure has been constructed to meet the requirements of the innovation strategy. As a result of the deployment of the quality function, two types of discontinuities were calculated: due to the existing innovation infrastructure as a whole, ensure successful implementation of the enterprise strategy and the degree to which each element of the innovation infrastructure corresponds to the requirements of the innovation strategy. The expediency of the use of cooperative interactions for the development of the innovation infrastructure is substantiated. A matrix model for the selection of the strategy for the development of the innovation infrastructure has been developed, taking into account the following parameters: the type and size of the gap, the organizational and financial complexity of the implementation of the reforms.

articleTitle: Formalization of Attack Prediction Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of information is inextricably linked with its security. The presence of vulnerabilities enables a third party to breach the security of information. Threat modeling helps to identify those infrastructure areas, which would be most likely exposed to attacks. In some cases, threat modeling cannot be classified as sufficient protection method. This paper entitled "Formalization of attack prediction problem" presents an analysis of different techniques with an attempt to identify the most informative parameters and attack prediction markers, which would lay the foundation for the development of attack probability functions. The obtained functional dependencies should be formally verified for further testing by a real system. The findings of this research could be applied during the future assessment of information system risk levels to ensure more effective information security management.

articleTitle: Bank Running Model’s Evolution on the Wave of Information and Communication Technology Development
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article looks into the causes and the consequences of a new banking business running model development. The main reason for a new customer service model development is caused by the introduction of progressive information and communication technologies into the banking business. The authors analyze the growth of distant customer service on the territory of the Russian Federation. They also point out the main difference between the traditional and the new banking service models. The authors discover new risks for banking business development connected to the use of information and communication technologies in banking service.

articleTitle: The Main Directions of Developing Organizational Measures at the Railway Enterprises in the Corporate Social Responsibility Aspect
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to the substantiation of the approach to the assessment of the economic efficiency of the enterprise of railway transport from the perspective of accounting for unproductive costs, the formation of effective interaction between enterprises and society in solving environmental problems. The authors analyze the quality of environmental management decisions by achieving the targets of corporate environmental programs. The article substantiates the approach to assessing the performance of the enterprise, in which the environment becomes an active element of management.

articleTitle: Predicting of Potential Risks and Revealing of the Facts of Possible Threats in the Organization of the Transport Safety Processes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the actual tasks of ensuring the safety of vehicles and objects of transport infrastructure, studies the methods of constructing a predict model using stochastic modeling. The results of designing a software complex for predicting risks in the transport infrastructure are presented, which collects statistical data from open sources and allows predicting potential threats and vulnerabilities for various types of vehicles. The approaches to ensuring transport security are suggested. A method for modeling transport security is presented.

Author Keywords: potential threats and vulnerabilities of transport security

articleTitle: Designing, Implementation and Use of Robotic Devices in the Social Sectors in Foreign Studies
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the analysis of foreign scientific studies on the use of robotic devices in social spheres such as entertainment, education and health care, for therapeutic purposes for children with autism spectrum disorder, for patients with sensorimotor disorders during rehabilitation, and robots for pets. Also, social robots can promote cooperation in the workplace, as well as help to educate and deepen understanding of students in the field of natural science subjects. The experience of applying social robots in education is exemplified. The article focuses on the problems of using robotic systems in the educational process, such as: the discrepancy between the abilities of the robot and the users' expectations, insufficient degree of adaptation required to use the robot in educational process taking into account the physical and social context, the problem of user privacy, users' fears during interaction with the robot and many other social aspects of human-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Increasing Export of Higher Education Services through Internationalization, based on Development of Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays considerable attention is given worldwide to the competitiveness, innovation, labour productivity, knowledge-based economy and digital economy. In the context of globalization, internationalization and postindustrial society universities are considered as drivers for territorial development while educational services are deemed a national/regional competitive advantage. In this respect, in recent times, we have witnessed a rapid growth of the global e-learning market. According to Global Industry Analyst the worldwide revenue of the global e-learning market was $52,6 billion in 2010 and is expected to reach $ 241 billion by 2022. The paper is devoted to the analysis of the peculiarities of e-learning and online learning practices of the leading exporters of higher education. The main features of online learning as an aspect of internationalization of higher education are considered. The current status and future development of online learning in the Russian Federation are determined.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling in the Calculation of the Dynamic Characteristics of Snow Avalanches
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mathematical modeling is used to calculate the parameters of avalanches in the assessment of avalanche danger and design of protective structures. The article presents a brief overview of the existing mathematical models of avalanches and their features. Empirical models based on statistical processing of avalanche data and dynamic models that take into account the physics of the process and allow calculating such parameters of the avalanche as the depth and velocity of the flow are considered. Models for dense, dusty avalanches and mixed type are considered. The paper presents the analysis of the possibility of using different models to calculate the main dynamic characteristics of snow avalanches.

articleTitle: Engines for Water Transport of Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The course of government of the Russian Federation for the development of the sea and river fleet is determined by a number of Federal target programs. These programs provide for the modernization of the composition of the sea, river and fishing fleet. The article provides an analysis of the current state of the civil fleet of the Russian Federation, as well as an overview of engines that are part of the power plants of vessels in service. Prospects for the development of shipbuilding in Russia on the basis of plans for the construction of ships for various purposes in accordance with the turnover and power of the engines are given. Achieving this goal should be ensured taking into account the policy of import substitution of the most important elements of sea and river technology.

articleTitle: The Lecturers’ Inter-University Collaboration during IT-Training Courses
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Increasing requirements to the content and form of higher education in conditions of digital economy set new tasks for professors: formation of applied competences, the involvement of students in project activities, provision of students' online support, their individual and project work. The growing load on university professors complicates satisfaction of these requirements. The development of the lecturers' network interaction makes it possible to redistribute the load for disciplines methodological provision. The article reveals possibilities of lecturers' network interaction by using innovative teaching methods including gaming forms and online courses. The research scientific novelty is to implement the lecturers' network interaction and experimental application of innovative teaching methods. Network interaction was carried out through the educational process of students' preparation in following areas: information security, applied information technology, business information technology.

articleTitle: Informational and Analytical Support of the Quality of Development of Innovation and Investment Projects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report analyzes the problems of obtaining and using information to ensure the quality of development and effective promotion of promising innovation and investment projects to the market. Features of the development of information marketing, as well as the growing role of modern marketing automated information systems are considered.

articleTitle: Creation of Automated Lump Sorting of Molybdenum-Containing Ores in the Technology of Forming the Quality of Ore Mass Flows at the Mining Stage
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: At the initial stage of the development of the Tyrnyauz deposit, complex scheelite and molybdenite containing ore were extracted, the processing of which was carried out by a single technological stream. Subsequently, monocomponent ores (molybdenum or tungsten-containing ores) are involved in mining. Since the mixing of monocomponent ores leads to mutual dilution, it is planned to separate them separately. At the same time, separate processing exacerbates the problem of oxidized molybdenum-containing ores.Separate sections of the deposit are susceptible to varying degrees of oxidation. The indicators of the existing enrichment technology with a degree of oxidation of molybdenite exceeding 10% deteriorate noticeably. According to the current technology from tungsten-molybdenum ores, the pellitite is extracted together with scheelite into the collective concentrate. In case of separate processing, the presence of calcium minerals in the ore makes it difficult to obtain rich primitic concentrates.To solve the problem, a technology has been developed for the formation of the quality of molybdenum-containing ores, including the zoning of the open field, the differentiation of the ore massifs that are different in terms of technological properties, and the selective excavation into an independent stream of ores from zones with increased oxidation of molybdenite. After the concentration of the levellite by the method of luminescent separation, the oxidized molybdenum-containing ores are processed separately. From coarse concentrate, after oxidation of molybdenite, the levellate leaching is carried out in the melt medium of a mixture of chloride and sodium silicate. The tail separation product is sent after grinding to flotation to form a molybdenum concentrate.The implementation of the technology is possible on the basis of a high level of automation of mining processes, in particular using special algorithms of robotic excavator intraboy sorting and an automated control system for intracatch piece separation.

articleTitle: Automated System for Forming the Quality of Ores at the Stage of Mining Operations for the Conditions of Flotation Enrichment with Hydrometallurgical Debugging
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: With the depletion of the rich mineral resources, in the world practice there has been a steady trend of involvement in extraction and processing of poor, difficult-to-digest, insufficiently studied ores. To maintain the level of profitability in conditions of deterioration of the raw material base of enterprises, the decisive factor is the increase in the complexity of the use of extracted minerals that contain and overburden. This, above all, refers to such large deposits in the Russian Federation. Such as the Tyrnyauz deposit of tungsten-molybdenum ores. To solve the problem of increasing the complexity of the use of mined raw materials, a new technology for the formation of ore quality at the stage of mining works is proposed, including: Technological mapping of ores, including the method of the beneficial use of the enclosing rocks; Technology of formation and stabilization of the quality of mineral flows for processing taking into account the useful use of ore and non-ore mineral raw materials; The processing technology is not critical to host rocks, aimed at selective maximum extraction of scheelite, powellit does not violate the original ratio of host rocks in the technological type of ores coming for processing. The implementation of the technology is possible on the basis of a high level of automation of mining processes, in particular using special algorithms of robotic excavator inside mine sorting and an automated control system for intra mine piece separation.

Author Keywords: integrated use of mineral raw materials

articleTitle: Industry-University Collaboration in Training Engineers (The Case of Sverdlovsk Region)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article summarizes the regional experience of training engineering specialists in practice-oriented programs. The data of the survey of industrial and technical bachelor programs graduates prepared on the order and based on large employers was analyzed. as well as data from secondary research of the author's sociological surveys materials, including the ones of seven stages of sociological monitoring of the socio-cultural portrait of students of the leading universities of the Sverdlovsk region "Student" 1995-2016 year. Conclusions are drawn that graduates of practical-oriented training programs are distinguished not only by high confidence in future employment, but also by more mature (deliberate) assessments of their level of readiness for professional work. The advantages and problems of training engineering specialists, "tooled for" the needs of specific employers, are revealed. The findings can be taken into account in the implementation of practice-oriented programs of technical specialists training.

articleTitle: An Approach for Constructing Indistinguishable Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Complex system contains more potential vulnerabilities. This article proposes the term "indistinguishable information system", which is a system that does not disclose any significant information about the algorithm of its functioning or objective function through side channels of information leakage by an iterative interaction. It improves security by making the system indistinguishable and hampering the exploring process. The research methodology consists of modeling indistinguishable characteristics depending of the system location in relation to the observer. The paper proposes a formal statement of the problem of protection against exploring, which is expressed in obtaining indistinguishable information systems through the objective function and side information leakage channels. It was proven that indistinguishable obfuscation makes it possible to obtain indistinguishability through side channels of data leakage. A method of making systems indistinguishable via the objective function was also proposed. The method feasibility was proven using the examples of remote code injection attacks.

articleTitle: Reengineering of Business Processes of JSC Gidrometallurg for Activity Improvement
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Activity of any enterprise represents set of the consecutive, directed to a definite purpose actions (business processes). The description and the analysis of business processes allow to estimate optimality of performance of process, to allocate excess operations, to define distribution of responsibility within process performance that in the subsequent, by means of reengineering to reconstruct activity of the organization in the best way.

articleTitle: Ergatic System of Complex Safety of Subjects of Education1
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Possible approaches to building the system of complex safety of education subjects are discussed in this paper. Characteristic of the proactive approach, based not on waiting for an extraordinary event and the elimination of its consequences, but on the identification and monitoring of risk factors as an alternative to the traditional retroactive approach is given. The structure of the ergatic model of complex safety and its elements are described. Proposes the original variant of the classification of threats to the subject of education. Discusses the principles of producing the information system of complex safety of education subjects.

Author Keywords: conceptual and informational models of system of complex safety

articleTitle: Freight Forwarding Space as a Component of Transport and Logistic
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this article the author's interpretation of the concept of transport space is offered, its brief characteristic is given. The basic features of the transport space and evidence of the existence of its variable hierarchy that allows observe the transport space at different levels of specificity, are specified. It is shown that freight forwarding can be considered as one of the subspaces of the transport space. It is proved that one of the main requirements for the development of this component should be the requirement to implement the maximum possible information conductivity of all its elements and links, and, therefore, the maximum interest of all its participants. An important role in the study of the transport process has been formulated. The described technique displays all the iterative components of the transport aspect.

articleTitle: High-speed Universal Digital Demodulator of the Intake of Stations of Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Create of questions of digital devices of demodulation and decoding of signals as a part of intelligent telecommunication satellite communication systems for the earth-based space stations providing the solution of current problems of territorial coherence considered.

articleTitle: Features of Using Moden IT-Technologies in Foreign Languages Teaching at Universities
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of positive and negative aspects of using information technologies in teaching foreign languages in higher education, as well as the development of didactic computer training.

articleTitle: The Stakeholders’ Feedback Mechanisms for Degree Programs Quality Assurance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the quality management of degree programs based on the PDCA cycle. Due to the duration of bachelor's and master's degree programs, the PDCA cycle should be used constantly during providing educational services to make management decisions promptly improving the degree program quality. The article describes the feedback mechanisms of the PDCA cycle on the stage Check both for the whole degree program and for each semester. At the same time, the following stakeholders provide the feedback: students after each semester, graduates at their graduation time, young alumni, who have worked after their graduation for 1-2 years, and employers having graduates among the personnel. These feedback mechanisms will allow assessing Degree Program Quality in a complex way. The article contains the regulations on using feedback mechanisms and its implementation based on the experience of Saint Petersburg Electrotechnical University.

articleTitle: Computer Safety Basics Training for the Older Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the experience of the project "Older generation - active users of the information space", conducted on the basis of the research center "Obrazovanye. Kachestvo. Otrasl" in partnership with the N. G. Chernyshevsky SSU. Explored issues: elderly people's social adaptation to life in the information society, components of training the elderly on the use of information technology in communication, household, receive public services, the conditions for the use of their skills to ensure information security. the article present the specific features of the developed distance learning course "Secure information environment" focused on the older generation. An online course created with the psychological and physiological characteristics of the older generation and the basic principles of andragogy.

articleTitle: Forecasting and Assessment of Innovative Factors of Technological Breakthrough in the Import Substitution and Food Security
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The doctrine of food security defined target indicators for which achievement it is necessary to make technological break on the basis of forecasting of development of agrarian and industrial complex in all its subsectors taking into account the having production and resource potential. Development of agricultural mechanical engineering and increase in security of agricultural producers with the equipment – key problems of strengthening of material and technical resources of agrarian and industrial complex which solution will allow to realize the import substitution program in agricultural industry.Technological forecasting will allow to plan the directions of scientific and technological development of agro-industrial complex, to carry out monitoring of the course of modernization of its material support.The critical dependence on import of Russia in agrarian and industrial complex is shown generally on means of production, but not on production of final consumption. Besides, most the domestic companies by production of agricultural machinery use foreign accessories. Sanctions against a number of commodity positions of production of agrarian and industrial complex of the USA, EU countries and some other states, served as an additional impulse in development of the import substitution program.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Using Big Data Technologies in Russian Financial Institutions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today's development of the world economy cannot be imagined without the implementation of digital technologies that transform entire economic sectors. Digital modernization of the world economy has led to the emergence of a new direction in economic development - the digital economy. It bases on the introduction of the most advanced information and communication technologies. In 2017, the state program "Digital Economy of the Russian Federation" was adopted in Russia. It provides the goals and tasks for implementing the state policy to develop the digital economy in Russia. The introduction and application of technologies for processing and analysis of big data are on the first place in this program. One of the leaders in this area in the Russian Federation is financial institutions. They have accumulated huge amounts of data for many years of their existence that require careful analysis and processing for further use. The paper analyzes modern technologies in the field of big data, reveals the most promising technologies that spread in the Russian market. In addition, the financial evaluation of the Russian big data market was carried out, the dynamics and growth rates were analyzed, future development was determined, the leaders in the application and implementation of these technologies were identified. The introduction and use of big data in Russian financial institutions were analyzed, the financial evaluation of the Russian big data market in the financial sphere was made, and the main directions of application of these technologies in credit institutions are defined. During the research, the reasons that hinder the more mass and rapid introduction of big data in Russian financial institutions were identified and considered.

articleTitle: Appraisal of Organization Efficiency of the Bed Fund of the Department of Maxillofacial Surgery in the Management of the Quality of Dental Aid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The conceptual issues of the complex assessment of the effectiveness of the organization of the bed fund of the Department of Maxillofacial Surgery and Dentistry of the Military Clinical Hospital in the management of the quality of dental care are considered. The general rules and algorithm for conducting a comprehensive assessment of the efficiency of the organization of the bed fund are presented, the calculations showing the need to optimize the capacity of the compartment for improving the quality of stationary dental care are graphically presented.

Author Keywords: assessment of the efficiency of the organization of bed capacity
optimization of the bed capacity of the department of maxillofacial surgery

articleTitle: Automatic Calculation of the Electricity Supply System in Tram Lines Design
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents automatic calculation of the electricity supply system data in order determine their compliance with standard limits and to determine the scope of measures to strengthen the electricity supply of existing lines and to create a power supply system for new lines.

articleTitle: Development of the Concept of Management of Economic Systems Processes through Construction and Calling of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article proposes an approach to modeling business processes of economic systems based on resource visualization on a business process diagram. The concept of management of economic systems processes based on machine learning has been developed. The method for predicting the route of execution of business processes using machine learning models based on naive Bayesian classifiers is being studied. This will significantly improve the efficiency of planning all the types of resources in the process management. In order to use trained models in real practice, the scheme for deploying machine learning models as web services is presented. The solutions offered by the author will let automatically send data to the trained model using REST API web service and get results in real time.

articleTitle: Search Optimization of Tutorial Web-Service Architecture for Cognitive Mathermatical Education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The world is changing and time does not stand still. Information technology surrounds us everywhere. The ways of giving, receiving, processing and storing information are changing. Information grows at a high rate, it is fragmented and inaccurate, which makes it difficult to perceive it. As an assistant for teaching mathematics, the EdITS system was developed and implemented in the educational process. Mathematics is a science applied in all fields of activity. A good knowledge of this discipline is important for both professional and personal development. Mathematics helps to form and develop the human cognitive abilities.

articleTitle: Determination of the Technical Level and Quality of Diamond Drill Bits, Represented in the World Market
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the quality and determines the technical level of the drill bits produced by OJSC Terekalmaz and gives recommendations for their improvement.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Cloud Computing Application in Russian and Foreign Financial Institutions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The modern world cannot be imagined without a massive introduction of information and communication technologies. The implementation of innovative digital technologies led to a digital transformation of entire industries. It was no coincidence that there emerged a term "digital economy", denoting economic sectors, in which use the most advanced information and communication technologies. Industry 4.0, financial technologies are the clear confirmation of the digital transformation of the economy. The main innovative directions in the field of information and communication technologies are cloud computing, Blockchain technology, processing and analysis of big data technology, the use of neural networks. One of the leaders in the field of implementing innovative digital technologies is financial institutions that are the second largest investor in IT projects after telecommunications companies. Today, cloud computing is the most popular innovative technology in the banking sector. The paper analyzes the prospects for adopting cloud technologies in Russian and foreign financial institutions. The research on the financial performance of the world market of cloud computing is conducted. The scope of cloud computing application in financial institutions is considered. Moreover, the comparative analysis between Russian and foreign banks, as well as in the financial sphere of the BRICS countries is carried out. The advantages for financial institutions when implementing cloud technologies are examined. Obstacles in adopting of cloud computing in the Russian financial institutions are investigated.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technologies in Problems of Medical Service
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed work is devoted to the study of the organization and planning of medical service. The study of queues in health care systems allows to determine the criteria for the functioning of the hospital system, the most significant are the average waiting time in the queue for hospitalization and the average length of the waiting queue. The reason for the emergence of a wide variety of queuing systems was the currently existing variants of applications, the features of their service, the formation of queues, the location, the number and organization of service channels. The possibilities of new achievements in medicine are not limited in theory, but in practice there is a shortage of doctors and nurses, lack of medicines, facilities, Finance, etc. in this regard, a lot of urgent problems arise, the solution of which would allow to use the available limited resources with maximum efficiency.

articleTitle: A Method of Use International Patent Resource in the Study of the Directions of Development of Innovative Technologies (on the Example of GLONASS / GPS)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes a method of use international patent resource in the study of the directions of development of innovative technologies (on the example of GLONASS / GPS). In order that innovations to ensure increased labor productivity and commercial income, it is necessary at the pre-project stage of their creation to conduct system studies in the relevant technological subject area, to identify the general state and direction of innovative technologies development in the world and / or in the territories of individual countries, identify competitors and determine the directions of their activity, to collect information about what technological projects they are working on [1]-[3] To solve such problems, innovative organizations around the world actively use international patent resources, since the patent is the first publication that can indicate a possible marketing plan of competitors, and 70-90% of information contained in patent documents is not published anywhere else.

articleTitle: The Use of Cellular Automata to Simulate the Dynamics of Snow Avalanches
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The numerical solution of the Navier-Stokes equations and its various modifications is considered to be a common approach in the simulation of snow avalanches dynamics. At the same time, there are difficulties with modeling turbulent flow, computational complexity, which in turn stimulates the search for alternative methods adapted for computer implementation. Recently, cellular automata - based modeling methods have been used to study various physical processes, which attract by their simplicity and versatility. The paper describes a quasi-three-dimensional and three-dimensional model of cellular automata for calculating the dynamics of snow avalanches. Avalanches are divided into small elements - cells or elementary machines. Each cell is characterized by its own parameters. The interaction between the cells is described by simple laws, which allows to simplify the calculation process.

articleTitle: On Supporting of the Young Children of Gorsky Princes and Paramount Noblemen Taken in the Caucasus in St. Petersburg’s Cadet Corps
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to a little-known and less studied scientific problem - the study of the selection, reception, placement, maintenance and training of Circassian amanates -highland students in Russian military schools (corps) in the late 1820s and early 1830s. century.

articleTitle: Problems and Prospects of Training for the Digital Economy: the Regional Dimension
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the age of computerization and high technologies, the digital economy affects all areas of activity: education, healthcare, business processes, quality management. The Digital Economy of the Russian Federation program notes that cadres and education are one of the key institutions within which conditions for the development of the digital economy are created. The article considers the conditions for the training of digital economy personnel at the regional level. An analysis of the education system is being carried out, which makes it possible to provide the digital economy with competent personnel in higher education institutions of the North Caucasus Federal District. The problems of interrelation between educational levels and digital training are considered.

articleTitle: The Problem of the Meaning of the Etruscan Term "Haruspicia" in the Abkhaz – Circassian Languages
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the Etruscan meaning of the term haruspicia, the first part of the word which is reconstructed as haru - "light from inside, the spirit from inside" on the Abkhaz-Circassian level, the second part is associated with the Latin verb specio (spicio) - "look, see, observe." The analysis of the lexico-semantic parallels, first of all, Abkhaz-Circassian and Hattian, allows the authors to make the conclusion that the Etruscan word haruspicia can be interpreted as a denotation of the light coming from within. This light in the image of the evil spirit is considered by witches and foretells fate.

articleTitle: Development of Transport Infrastructure in the North-West of Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyses the existing state of the logistics system of the North-Western region of Russia, which provides transportation of such strategic cargoes as coal, ore and steel in the framework of international trade with the European countries. Russia's policy in ensuring military security of the infrastructure created in the region is substantiated and disclosed.

articleTitle: Controlling the Quality of the Selection of Transitions in the Design of Technological Operations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The basic approaches to the description of design tasks of technological equipment of operations in the technological process of manufacturing products based on correspondence tables with a matrix of binary relations are described. The technique for describing design tasks by the user with the help of special tools is considered. The expediency of using the design tasks bases in the design of operations of the technological process is shown.

Author Keywords: a system of complex automation of technology
a correspondence table with a matrix of binary relations

articleTitle: Experience and Prospects for the Development of Online Testing System of Economic Knowledge of Engineering Students at LETI
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the experience of applying the system of online testing of students' knowledge of technical fields and specialties in the discipline "Economics of organization". Prospects and directions of development of this system are considered.

articleTitle: Informative Support of Management of Innovation and Investment Processes in the Conditions of Structural Modernization of the Region’s Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Russia in general exists in the conditions of the multipolar world, but also in national economy polarization of development of regions continues, the signs of asymmetry of their development caused by multiformity of national economy become aggravated. It leads to aggravation of a rupture of economic space of the country and growth of number of problem regions with deep contradictions of social and economic and political character. Now the urgent need in implementation of restructuring of economy, identification of the so-called locomotive priority directions of development in the medium and long term is obvious. Such statement of the designated problems causes the necessity in systematization of methodological approaches to a basic research of interactions and interrelations of structural elements of the institutional environment of innovative and investment clusters and their transformation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Stress-Strain State of Two-Layer Reinforced Cement Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the results of studies of the stress-strain state of single-layer and two-layer armocement elements under pure bending. The results of field and numerical experiments have good convergence.

Author Keywords: stress-strain state of reinforcement cement elements

articleTitle: Development of Program-Algorithmic Support for Estimation of the Influence of Unauthorized Landfills on Nature and Human Activity on the Basis of Geoinformation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The issue of classification, emergence, as well as the influence of unauthorized landfills on nature and human activity is considered. The methods of dividing the terrain into sectors are described, where a complex of factors of the impact of unauthorized dumps on the surrounding terrain is considered in detail. The author substantiates the necessity of developing software and algorithmic support on the basis of geoinformation systems for estimation of this impact.

articleTitle: About Modeling of Removal of Pollutants from the Territory of Irrigated Lands with the Development of Irrigation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the task of irrigation development is relevant. Without the development of irrigation, the problem of food security of the country cannot be solved. At the same time, the development of irrigation is accompanied by the emergence of environmental problems. Therefore, it is impossible to solve the problem of irrigation development without assessing the impact of irrigation on the environment. The article deals with the problem of assessing the removal of pollutants from irrigated land.

articleTitle: The Algorithm for Searching the Delay of Quasi-Periodic Noise-Like Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An algorithm is proposed for parallel algorithm of delay search for a quasi-periodic noise-like signal with a minimum frequency modulation. It is shown that with a slight loss in noise immunity (0.9dB), the considered algorithm provides significant advantages in implementation in comparison with the optimal algorithm, allowing to reduce the implementation requirements.

articleTitle: Selection Strategy of a Linguistic Base for Software Development, Functioned in Engineering CAD-Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The modern software market provides application programmers a diverse selection of tools for program development. It is necessary to choose the right software envelope in which the software product will be created when developing complex science-intensive software, which is connected in a large number of mathematical calculations and functioning in engineering CAD systems. The article is devoted to the problems of software selection strategy for the development of structures' engineering analysis.

articleTitle: Evolution of Educational Programs in the Field of Digital Production
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: the article describes the stage of transition from training in the field of CALS-technologies to complex provision of the needs of enterprises with personnel owning digital production technologies.

Author Keywords: Continuous Acquisition and Life cycle Support

articleTitle: Instrumental Means of Increasing the Productivity and Quality of Work in the Technological Preparation of Machine-Building Production
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article provides information on the functional capabilities of the system for the integrated automation of the technological preparation of machine-building production (SKAT), created in the Gubkin Russian State University of Oil and Gas.

articleTitle: Fiber Optic Sensor for Precise Detection of the Moment of Passage of Reflective Labels
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the main factors affecting the accuracy of recording the movement of an object using an amplitude fiber optical sensor with external modulation of the radiation flux is analyzed. The structural scheme, the operating principle and the algorithm for processing the measuring information of a non-contact infrared sensor for recording the moment of passage of a reflective mark are given. The variants of using the developed sensor in the monitoring systems of technological equipment are considered.

articleTitle: Analysis and Automation of Business Processes of Mass Events Using Situational Management Methodology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In a modern world, organization of mass events of various kinds is rapidly becoming ever more popular. Organization of any event requires a serious preparation and considerable amount of various resources. Organizers ever more frequently conclude that they need to use information systems for preparation and delivery of such events. This paper describes the process automation experience for planning and conduct of an annual event during a period of several years.

articleTitle: Prediction of Investment Processes in the Context of Cluster Diversification of the Problem Regions' Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of mechanisms for the revival of the regional economy is of increased interest, to maximize the use of all elements of the regional potential of the economy. At the same time, it is of great importance to predict the growth of innovation and investment activity through cluster diversification and transformation of the regional economy. This requires the systematization of information on the mechanism of management of innovative sphere, as a strategic factor for the achievement of identified problems. Forecasting of innovation and investment activity and attractiveness of production and non-production sectors of the region should be based solely on the results of scientifically based diagnosis, analysis, evaluation of its competitive profile in all sectors of the regional economy. Thus, there is an urgent need to identify the priority areas of locomotive and forecast the development of the economy of problem regions in the medium and long term.

articleTitle: Development of a Mathematical Model of Thread Cutting in the Holes of Ultra-Small Diameters Using a Blade Anode-Machining
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers a mathematical model of the moment formation on the cutting tool axis in the processing of threaded holes of super small diameters (≤1,4) with the use of blade anode-mechanical treatment (AMT). A mathematical model of the formation point on the axis of the cutting tool when machining the threaded hole ultra-small diameter taking into account the influence of the electrochemical dissolution of descending chips.

articleTitle: Adaptation of Reliability Calculation Software Packages for High Performance Distributed Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: MPI-powered computations are extremely time-efficient. Thereby, parallel computation of reliability algorithms would allow us to provide rapid response to changes in technical conditions of artificial constructions.

articleTitle: Simulation of Advertising Activity in Tourist Business
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Advertising budgets of large corporations are measured in hundreds of millions and even billions of dollars, and advertisers require reliable evidence of their justification. Since the main purpose of production activities is profit, all aspects of the company's activities, including advertising, should contribute to achieving this goal.So, advertising, which at the beginning of its existence was seen as the necessary costs for informing buyers, now acquires the functions of a profit generator. Scientists began to study the effectiveness of advertising, analyzing the relationship between profit and advertising costs [2].It is very important that advertising reaches potential consumers and does not cover an audience that will not buy products [3]. In addition, it is important to optimize the distribution of the company's advertising budget in order to maximize the reach of the target audience. Targeting (targeted advertising) - the marketing mechanism used to address this issue.

articleTitle: Stochastic Approach to Analysis of System of Integrity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Stochastic method of determination of system integrity based on the use of mathematical apparatus of equations Fokker-Plank-Kolmogorov in the class of systems described by stochastic differential equations.

articleTitle: The Determination of Contact Temperature during Mechanical Treatment of Materials
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: the analysis of methods for determining the contact temperature in the blade and diamond-abrasive processing of materials, including the processing of natural stones. A method for determining the contact temperature in the machining of materials with different physical and mechanical properties is proposed. The method involves continuous feed of the tool toward the thermocouple and simultaneous oscillography its output voltage and determining the approximating function for the temperature distribution in the processed material. In the process of cutting, the tool is stopped when the optimum distance between the tool and the thermocouple is reached, and to determine the contact temperature, the approximating function obtained at the stage of their approximation is extrapolated at the remaining area of cutting.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Assessment of CMOS as Element of the Face Identification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a more refined technique for calculating the integrated sensitivity of TV systems on a CMOS matrix from the brightness of a luminous image, which is based on the most accurate dependence of the optical transmission coefficient on brightness. This technique is used in the face identification algorithm. The algorithm of identification found application in e-learning when passing the procedure of state final certification.

articleTitle: Software Algorithm for Evaluating the Effectiveness of the Financial Message Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The objective of this research is to develop a software algorithm for evaluating the effectiveness of using the Financial Message Transfer System for Remote Banking Systems. The study considers hardware system that provide two types of interactions between the legal entity and the bank: ≪Direct Banking≫ and ≪Internet Banking≫. During the work were identified and analyzed the main features of remote banking systems and determined the efficiency criteria of the systems. Based on the analysis output, were developed and proposed a mathematical model for evaluating the effectiveness of considered systems thought using the cost and quantity coefficients of system ensuring, as well as the financial and economic business performance indicators. In accordance with the proposed mathematical model, was constructed an algorithm that makes it possible to obtain quantitative estimates of Remote Banking Systems effectiveness. The developed algorithm belongs to the heuristic class and is based on the analysis of both the open statistical and the modeled by simulation tools data. The conducted computational experiments reflects the efficiency of the proposed mathematical model, as well as an algorithm based on the developed model.

articleTitle: Development of a Computer Program to Predict the Expected Parameters of the Accuracy of the Future Product Manufactured by Rapid Prototyping Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a program that allows you to get the expected parameters of the accuracy of the future product manufactured by one of the three methods of rapid prototyping technology. The principle of its work on the basis of variation of the most important factors is shown, descriptions of all working blocks of the program are given.

articleTitle: The Technology of Forming the Quality of Inert Materials in the Unloading Zones of the Floodplains of Rivers for the Conditions of Automated Lump Sorting
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The work is devoted to environmentally safe exploitation of resources in floodplains of highland rivers, improvement of production technology, regeneration of reserves of inert materials, using automated lump sorting of mined minerals.

articleTitle: Modern Information Society and its Impact on the Education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article considers the concept of information society, its role and place in education. The tendencies in education determined by the development of the modern information society are affected.

articleTitle: Description of Relation between Speed and Traffic Flow Density by Modification of Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Method for approximation of speed (km/h) and traffic flow density (auto/km) relation by new square least method in mathematical traffic flow models is presented. The main idea of modification of least square method is minimization of sum square distances between experimental points and prime line. The non-uniqueness of the problem's solution and reduce the variance of the approximation compared to the classical approach are shown.

articleTitle: Schematic and Design Aspects of Interference Immunity in the Design of Analog Devices Electronic Means
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of the analysis of noise immunity of analog EM nodes for the example of amplifying devices in integrated design, presents the results of noise immunity analysis, presents its estimates and recommendations on noise-proof design of amplifying nodes, substantiates the expediency of using two fundamentally different characteristics of noise immunity - the effectiveness of protection and noise immunity.

articleTitle: Development of Quantitative Methods for Evaluating Intellectual Resources in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper outlines the concept of the Digital economy, defines the role and types of intellectual resources in the context of digitalization of the economy, reviews existing approaches and methods to intellectual property valuation and analyzes drawbacks of quantitative evaluation of intellectual resources (based intellectual property valuation) related to: uncertainty, noisy data, heterogeneity of resources, nonformalizability, lack of reliable tools for measuring the parameters of intellectual resources and non-stationary development of intellectual resources. The results of the study offer the ways of further development of methods for quantitative evaluation of intellectual resources (inter alia aimed at their capitalization).

articleTitle: Development of the Conceptual Structure of the System for Ensuring the Functional Safety of Modern Transport Systems under the Conditions of Intentional Electromagnetic Influences
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main structural elements of the system for ensuring the functional safety of modern transport control systems under the conditions of intentional electromagnetic influences.

articleTitle: Algorithm Parallelizing for Classifying the Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents one of the approaches to parallelizing the classification of algorithm for complex systems in condition of uncertainty. The offered variant of the parallelization of the classification of algorithm is based on the separation of the processed set of objects between performers.

articleTitle: Increase of Efficiency of Activity of the Branch Enterprises in a Context of Technologies of Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the formation of an effective quality management system in instrument engineering. Sectoral characteristics influencing the formation of quality management tools are determined. Regulations on the analysis of the system of product quality in instrument manufacture at the stages of incoming inspection, experimental and serial production and operation of products have been developed. The sectoral indicators of the quality of the product's produced, as well as the initial quality information, are established. The need to identify risks at all stages of the life cycle and methodological provisions for their prevention has been identified.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Detecting Potato Defects Using Images in the Infrared Range of Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An automated system for contactless thermal quality testing of potato moving along a chain conveyor is presented. The algorithm of the computer vision system for the recognition of potato defects in real time is described.
