The method for detecting defects is based on determining the temperature difference between healthy and damaged tissues after short-term heating of the tubers.

articleTitle: The Use of Information Technology in Teaching Occupational Health and Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Methodology of use of information technologies in teaching of discipline of "The base of labor safety" is considered. The main requirements to the structure and basic elements of electronic manual are determined. The role of management system of labor safety in modern system of student's teaching is justified. Examples of those topics and questions are presented, which should be discussed during practical lessons. Educational elements on various topics of labor safety are developed, and should be used for independent work. Three-stage system of the evaluation of mastering presented material is offered.

articleTitle: Methods of Assessment of Compliance of the Regional University as a Driver of Innovation with the Principles of SMART-education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Digitalization makes it necessary to change the education system in accordance with the principles of SMART-concept. The retrospective analysis of the sphere of education in Russia shows that today the University is the center of the innovation space of the regional economic system. The study presents the process of transformation of the regional University development model in the conditions of transition to the digital economy from the standpoint of the life cycle theory and the laws of the organization. The method of estimation of conformity of regional University as a driver of innovations to the principles of SMART-education concept is offered. The methodology is based on an integrated approach to assessing the potential of the University. It allows you to determine the level of readiness of the University to move to a new model of education in accordance with the selected criteria.

articleTitle: Issues of Improving the Design Quality of the Roadbed of High-Speed Railways and Railways in the Arctic Zones
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses some methodological issues that arise in the determination of the physical and mechanical properties of soils and other building materials and in the design of the roadway for high-speed rail lines and rail lines in the Arctic regions.

articleTitle: Directions of Transport Development in Advanced Marketing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reveals the relative characteristics of transport's models. The problems of the transport industry development are presented. The PEST-analysis of the influence of transport factors on the development of markets. The advantages and disadvantages of different modes of transport are considered. The structure of costs by modes of transport is disclosed.

articleTitle: Features of Implementation of a Quality Management System at Enterprises of the Industrial Sector (the Case of ALMAZ Group of Companies)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper discusses the features of implementation of a unified quality management system in the group of companies, ways of dealing with the staff resistance when the top management initiates the project as well as the procedure of implementation of an integrated project.

Author Keywords: integration of QMS in a group of companies

articleTitle: Role of Practice in The Process of Training Modern
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, the most important part of education process in any sphere in the development context of the information society is internship and familiarization practice. Its goal is not only to apply the knowledge gained in learning process, but the ability to accumulate those innovative technologies that are used by companies operating in the market. How is it necessary to organize the practice of students to be effective, motivating for future professionals? What tools are best to use for the introduction of innovative technologies in the educational process? These and other questions will be discussed in this article.

articleTitle: Selection of the Optimum Grinding Angle for Knives for Meat Grinders by Computer Simulation of the Stress-Strain State
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the quality and determines the technical level of the drill bits produced by OJSC Terekalmaz and gives recommendations for their improvement.

articleTitle: The Effect of Innovative Tax Leverage and the Ability to "Quasi Self-Finansing" Innovation Activities of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to consider the effect of innovative tax leverage, that is, increase in the growth of basic taxes - value added tax, personal income tax and income tax from each ruble of sales with a one-percent increase in the share of value added in the structure of the value of industrial enterprises. The method of calculation of innovative tax leverage and the formula for calculating the maximum possible effect of its action on individual taxes and contributions to state social funds, as well as the formula for calculating the actual effect on these types of taxes and deductions. The increase in the amount of basic taxes received as a result of the intensification of innovation activities, the state and regions can allow the use of innovation-active enterprises in full or in part to further enhance their innovation activities, subject to the conclusion of appropriate contracts.

articleTitle: Algorithm of End-to-End Integrated Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: End-to-end integrated quality management is a wide spread term, however, it is no special definition or algorithm for its application. In this paper, authors' definition is provided. It is associated with thought and ideas in this field of the most famous quality management specialist such as Taylor, Deming, Juran, Feigenbaum, Dodge, Romig, Shewhart, Crosby, and Taguchi. Moreover, quantification of usage measures is discussed. Fuzzy logic as one of the mathematic basics of the algorithm is proposed. At the result of the paper, algorithm of end-to-end integrated quality management is presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of Non-Stationary Thermal Processes in Composite Diamond-Containing Materials
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The nonstationary temperature fields in the "diamond-matrix" system of instruments on polymer and hard alloy matrices are studied numerically. The time dependences of the transitional thermal process and the steady-state temperature on the thermophysical properties of the matrix and heat transfer to the external environment are determined.

articleTitle: Regional Economy Clustering as Effective Import Substitution Factor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The import substitution strategy has become a reaction to foreign policy conditions and the followed-up economic situation. This strategy requires not only the restructuring of the national economy, but also reviewing the approaches to improving the regional competitiveness. In this regard, the regional economy structure should be both sector and interdisciplinary and ensure the integration of various economic activity sphere representatives. One of the most effective approaches under such circumstances can be the regional economy clustering. It allows ensuring the domestic goods production and services using Russian scientific research results, which will solve significant social and economic problems, such as economic growth, employment, higher living standards for population and, consequently, increasing consumer activity.

articleTitle: The Investigation of the Processing of Metals by a Loose Abrasive on the Basis of Analysis of Loose Particles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Effective shot blasting or sandblasting of metal surfaces requires the selection of machining conditions that corresponding to the properties of the contaminants removing and the metal to get processed. The choice of processing mode in a production environment is generally limited selection of stamps (dispersion) of abrasive material and the operating pressure of the air. This approach does not allow to achieve the greatest efficiency of the processing and leads to production losses. The paper presents the results of a investigation of the modes for abrasive blasting metal processing based on the analysis of the loose particles.

articleTitle: The Restoration of the Operational Status of Buildings after the Subsidence of the Foundation in Conditions of High Mountains
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the reasons for the subsidence and the experience of restoring the operational state of the building of the operator station of the passenger cable car to the Elbrus mountains at the level of +3450,42 m above sea level.

articleTitle: A Change in the Salt Regime of Irrigated Lands under Irrigation Development and its Impact on the Salinity of Rivers-Water Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of irrigation development in the zone of insufficient moisture, changes in the water-salt regime of irrigated lands and the impact of irrigation on the change in the level of groundwater, its mineralization. For the territory of the irrigation system, the problems of determining the total evaporation (by the method of A. I. Budagovsky) and irrigation regime are considered. As a consequence of irrigation, the problem of influence of salts from the territory of the irrigation system on the mineralization of rivers-water receivers. To assess the latter, the basin method was applied.

articleTitle: Surface Quality in Cutting Process as the Result of Reflection of Dynamic Characteristics of an Elastic System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The issues related to the influence of dynamic characteristics of a machine elastic system on the treated surface quality in turning are discussed. The results of the experimental studies carried out while cutting with a lathe accompanied by the imposition of vibrations of different levels on the cutting tool with the following spectral analysis of the surface profilograms are given. The regularities of the formation of surface waviness depending on the frequency of vibrations and the dynamic characteristics of an elastic system are given.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Formation of Requirements for the IMS Implementation in Accordance with the New Standards
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article cover the aspect ensuring the safety of modern complex industrial facilities (CIF) and critical infrastructure, various methodological tools are used, including Integrated Management Systems (IMS). At present, practically for the management of each CIF there is a IMS, consisting of several standards, United by a single risk-oriented approach. As a rule, such IMS cover most of the business processes of CIF, but in practice there are examples of different scope, even within the boundaries of one object. However, it should be recognized that the total number of such projects in the Russian Federation is small and the culture of application and independent evaluation of CIF in terms of security (functional - in General and information - in particular) is still at an initial level. This article attempts to analyze the situation on the basis of the first step of the process of application of any standard - the formation of the context.

articleTitle: Calibration of Dry Friction and Turbulent Drag Coefficients in the Calculation of the Dynamic Characteristics of Snow Avalanches
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mathematical modeling is used to calculate the parameters of avalanches in the assessment of avalanche danger and design of protective structures. The computer program RAMMS, developed at the Swiss Institute for snow and avalanche studies (SLF), is widely used for calculation of avalanche movement by a two-dimensional hydraulic model in real relief conditions. A necessary condition for the application of this mathematical model in practice is the calibration of the values of the coefficients of dry friction and turbulent resistance from the data of real avalanches. The article presents the results of calibration of these factors for avalanches of different types.

articleTitle: Application of Information and Communication Technologies in Solving Environmental Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed work is devoted to the application of game-theoretic methods, as well as the application of information and communication technologies for the study of issues related to solving environmental problems. The game model, which simulates the conflict situation of atmospheric pollution, is constructed in the work. The research of the static game-theoretic model of rationing of harmful substances is conducted, as well as several games in which conditions for the existence and uniqueness of equilibrium situations in pure strategies are found, and also the optimal solutions are indicated. The optimization of the choice of the amount of fines for pollution has been carried out. The program for calculating the concentration of harmful impurities is compiled in Pascal.

articleTitle: To the Issues of the Company’s Target Management System Formation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The formation of company's target management system and the problems of structuring and streamlining the types of management from the standpoint of methodology, tools and techniques are considered in the given paper. There has been substattiated the need for developing alternative models for the formation of company's target management system based on ISO 9001. The choice of management toolkit and its optimum range for specific industries and solution of these industries's primary tasks are covered.

articleTitle: Quality Assurance of Hull Elements of Radio-Electronic Equipment by Means of Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Industrial robots play an important role in the technical re-equipment of enterprises in recent years. On their basis, it is possible to form complexes with the possibility of rapid changeover, which, for the most part, are designed for integration into flexible automated sections and lines. The greatest efficiency of automation due to PR can be achieved through an integrated approach to the creation, implementation of robots and subsequent quality assurance of products. One of the important and gaining in popularity are systems, including industrial robots, producing three-dimensional parts and products, the use of which is widespread in the electronic industry to create a corpus of items of electronic equipment from a variety of polymers.

articleTitle: Problems and the Prospects of Training for Providing the Gain of High-Performance Jobs in the Conditions of Cluster Diversification and Digitalization of the Russian Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Results of the analysis of problems and the prospects of creation and staffing of high-performance jobs in the region in the conditions of transition to digital economy are presented in article. On the basis of use of general scientific ways of systematization and group of data, comparisons, logiko-analytical assessment of parameters are defined purposes and the directions of development of personnel capacity of Kabardino-Balkarian Republic, an assessment of a role of regional higher education institution in activization of processes of creation and modernization of high-performance jobs is given. Results of the analysis can be used in the course of development and realization of strategy of innovative development of the region and also the program of modernization and creation of new high-performance jobs in the territory of the republic.

articleTitle: Psychological Management of Teaching as a Perspective Form of Increasing the Quality of Education
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of increasing the effectiveness of teaching students, the use of new teaching methods, with regard to advanced educational forms, modern methods of educational process, enhancing the role of psychological and pedagogical support of educational process.

Author Keywords: psychological and pedagogical support of the educational process

articleTitle: Dialogue Models and their Ethnomental Invariants in the folkloric Texts of the Circassian Countries: the Tale about Roughwood-Legged, Egg-Shelled Head and the Thin-Haired Ваd-Voiced Brothers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the systematic and comprehensive study of the Circassian countries folkloric heritage. An unfamiliar text which we titled "Tale about Rough - woodlegged Egg - shelled and the Thin - haired bad-voiced brothers" is presented for the first time to the scientific society. Also special attention is paid to the Circassian poetical names - metaphors which enlighten ethnonational and specific world vision.

articleTitle: Criteria for Assessing the Quality of Applications Submitted for Participation in Visa Competitions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the criteria used to assess the quality of applications submitted for participation in scientific competitions. Based on the results of the experiment, fourteen basic criteria were determined: the quantitative characteristics of the groups of participants in the application and separately for the leader. To determine the relationship between each characteristic and the result obtained, the Pearson correlation coefficient was calculated. Based on the results of the experiment, comparative diagrams are constructed with estimates of the dependency between the result of the application and the characteristics of the group of participants and the leader.

articleTitle: The Adaptation of Information Modeling Software for the Metal Truss Bridges Design and Utilize Bridges
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the actual problem of using information models of construction objects put into operation. At this stage, there is a need for special software, which should be connected with the finished information model. It is proposed to use the application programming interface Open API, integrating the necessary algorithms of calculation and analysis into the system to make the process of updating the information model more efficient. The variants of the new dialog boxes created with the Tekla Open API are shown, which illustrate the possibilities of this approach to correct information models of bridges created in the Tekla program.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model in the Form of a Loaded Second-Order Parabolic-Hyperbolic Equation with a Singular Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this work we prove the unique solvability of the boundary value problem for a mixed second-order parabolic-hyperbolic equation. The solubility of this problem is reduced to Cauchy problem in the hyperbolic problem and to Goursat problem in the parabolic part of the domain of the given equations.

articleTitle: Electronic Applications for Developing the Competencies of Engineering Personnel in Dynamic Economic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers modern approaches to the development of key competencies of engineering personnel based on electronic applications. The advantages and disadvantages of using such applications in fast and dynamically developing economic systems are analyzed. The case of the use of modern teaching technologies and applications in the world practice is given.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Surface Charge of Spherical Particles for Mechatronic Systems for Remote Monitoring of Hail Clouds
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mechatronic monitoring systems based on radar systems are widely used for the study of natural hazards, which include thunderstorm- hail clouds. Hail clouds are a complex polydisperse system of particles of different shapes and it is obvious that to improve the accuracy of detection and recognition requires the development of mathematical models and efficient algorithms to calculate the characteristics of the scattering of electromagnetic waves by particles of different shapes, taking into account various factors, in particular, the surface charge on the hail particles.The article is devoted to the actual problem-the development of a mathematical model for calculating the coefficients of attenuation, scattering and radar reflection of electromagnetic waves by spherical hail particles taking into account surface charges. It is shown that when the density of surface charges tends to zero, the obtained relations tend to the known formulas for neutral particles, and when the surface density of charges tends to infinity, they tend to the relations for perfectly conducting spherical particles.

articleTitle: On Foreign Experience of Import Substitution: Lessons for Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The experience of import substitution in the countries of Latin America and South-East Asia is considered. The interpretations and motives of import substitution are set out. The peculiarities, problems and successes in carrying out import substitution policy are considered. The role of the state and the importance of investment are shown. Conclusions are drawn about the significance of foreign experience of import substitution for Russia.

Author Keywords: the countries of the Latin American region

articleTitle: Methods of Probability Density Function of Non-Gaussian Processes Approximation in Information-Measuring Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the methods of formation of non-Gaussian processes with application of functional approximation of probability density function (PDF), as well as one-dimensional and specially constructed transient PDF. The results of modeling the two-dimensional Laplace PDF are presented.

articleTitle: Informative, Expert and Analytical Support of Effective Managerial Decision-Making Innovative-Investment Processes in the Economy of the Region
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An important role in making innovative decisions is played by information support, the timeliness and reliability of which depend on the economic results of innovation. It is necessary to have models and algorithms that provide a real assessment of investment projects both at the design stage and at the project implementation stage, taking into account the probabilistic nature of the results of innovation, when the degree of uncertainty is higher, the more risks. More broadly, it is necessary to significantly strengthen the scientific and, above all, methodological and methodological support for solving problems related to the management of innovation development. The subject of the research is innovative processes, tools, methods and technologies of innovation management of regional economic systems based on modern information technologies, as well as the assessment of information support and management decision support experts.

articleTitle: The Attitude of Computer Science Teachers to the Nuances of Teaching Computer Security for Junior Schoolchildren
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the features of perception by computer science teachers in the learning process of computer security for younger students. It analyzes data collected from the studied literature as well as the teachers' survey of Saratov and Saratov region about their attitudes to the dangers of the childrens' enthusiasm for social networks, and monitoring students' behavior in social networks. The article discusses the inclusion of law and ethical topics in computer science course. According to the research results it can be concluded that there is negligible diversity of points of teachers' view in this matter. The prevailing view is that there is sufficient consideration of computer security in the school.However, realizing the importance of working with parents on this issue teachers are not always willing to cooperate.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Quality of International Instruments Determining the Interaction of States in the Exploration of Near-Earth Space
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article proposes a classification of the main international documents that determine the interaction of States in exploration of outer space and presented the composition of modern legal normative instruments on the use of near-Earth space. It is shown that currently there is a problem "International legal instruments on the near-Earth space exploration don't work as planned". Using the quality tools, authors showed and analysed key categories affecting this problem.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Machine-Building Production
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the structure of digital production and recommendations for the implementation of the main stages of automation of machine-building production on the principles of end-to-end digitization.

articleTitle: Main Self-Educational Platforms in Russia and Skills that Can Be Develop Via Them
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to information technologies in self-education usage. These technologies are very different and provide distinguish educational opportunities in many formats. In Russia Internet three main types of informational resources for self-education are platforms, that provide materials; MOOC platforms and separate platforms, that are alternative to regular education. As a result, each person has to choose the subject and the way of self-education. The set of the activities for information or course search and choose, helps people not just improve their knowledge in particular field, but also develop their personal characteristics, such as independence, decision making, planning and subjective control. Therefore, information technologies for self-education are important in remote regions. It can be one of the best educational opportunities for professional and self-development.

articleTitle: Marketing Activity Management Improvement for Small-Series Production Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article elaborates marketing activity management improvement mechanism for small-series production enterprises, differed with choosing the best marketing activity variant on base of several possible variants imitation. This elaborated mechanism includes method of defining marketing activity effect, taking into account profit, clients satisfaction and market impact, which allow making more backgrounded and effective management decisions.

articleTitle: Calculating the Effect of Electricity Quality on Technical and Economic Performance of Transformers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report presents an analysis of academic and technical literature describing the assessment of the influence of the quality of electricity on the operation of a power transformer. We analyze a methodology for calculating additional power losses as well as that for calculating the excessive temperatures of power transformer windings caused by low quality of the supply voltage. Existing methodology is also specified and our own approach to the assessment of the effect of non-sinusoidal voltage on transformers' technical and economic performance is suggested. We separately analyze the effect of voltage imbalance and non-sinusoidal supply voltage on transformer's performance and its technical and economic performance. The results obtained are introduced into modern education techniques.

Author Keywords: excessive temperatures of power transformer windings

articleTitle: Method to Identify Contact Interference Source on Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper gives the results of development of a method to identify contact interference source on vehicle, which occurs during radio communication in motion. Identification is based on measuring resonance frequency of the radiating circuit and determining its spatial orientation. Radiating circuit equivalent dimension is determined on the basis of measuring its resonance frequency. Radiating circuit spatial orientation is determined on the basis of analysis of transmitting and receiving antenna field components. The method does not require the use of complex measuring equipment and can be applied in field. Vehicle-installed radio stations can be used as means to detect radiating circuits.

articleTitle: About a High-Precision Graphoanalytical Method of Determination of Critical Forces of an Oblate Rod
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the construction mechanics courses (a strength of materials, technical mechanics, structural mechanics, mechanics of a solid deformable body) the phenomenon of stability loss of oblate rod stock takes the important place as in most cases at the same time there are larger deformations, transition of material to plastic condition and, even, destruction of a design. At the same time the practice of students tutoring in higher education institutions and their further activity as construction engineers shows that the solution of a task on rod stock stability causes serious difficulties, especially for nonclassical calculated schemes. In this work it is offered to simplify significantly by means of computer technology the solution of the difficult tasks on stability of an oblate rod and at the same time to reach big obviousness.

Author Keywords: innovations at projection of transport structural objects

articleTitle: Quality Manual for Medical Research Companies Actualization According to GOST R ISO 9001-2015
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the necessary changes and inovations in the quality management system according to the new version of GOST R ISO 9001-2015. The experience of actualization the manual of quality in scientific and medical institutions through preparing to recertification in accordance with a requirements of GOST R ISO 9001-2015.

articleTitle: Concept of a Virtual Workshop on ICT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The concept of a virtual workshop on disciplines of ICT is described. Options of realization of virtual practical works are considered. The architecture of a virtual practical work, invariant to basic disciplines of ICT is given. An example of a workshop on the course "Administration of Networks" is reviewed.

articleTitle: New Paradigms of Decision-Making and Qualimetry
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes new paradigms of decision-making. Now the most urgent decision-making problems are the problems with uncertainty, which take place, when there is no information on probabilities, and the decisions are being accepted on the basis of subjective judgments of decision-maker. In spite of the fantastic computer progress, the most difficult problems unlikely will be solved by quantitative methods. Main decisions in human history were subjective, as they have been made by the persons. Making a choice from a set of alternatives, a person evaluates their quality, connecting the objective aspects with his (her) personal values. This fact explains an impossibility of an "objective" choice in principle, even if there is exact quantitative information for decision-making. Therefore, further we shall imply the decision-making problems under uncertainty.

articleTitle: On a Nonlocal Model with Operators of Fractional Integro-Differentiation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: We investigate a nonlocal boundary-value problem for a mixed second-order parabolic-hyperbolic equation in a bounded. The uniqueness theorem for the solution of the problem is proved by the method "abc". The solvability of the boundary value problem is reduced to the question of the solvability of the corresponding integral equations.

articleTitle: Formation of Communicative Competences in the Frames of the Quality Management Degree Programs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The issues of training specialists in quality management as one of the directions for the development of the Russian economy are discussed. The structure of formation of communicative competences for students in the field of Quality Management at SPbETU "LETI" is given.

articleTitle: “Quasi Self-financing” Innovative Activity of Enterprises as an Element of the System of State-Private Partnership
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The possibilities and sources of financial support to stimulate innovative activity of industrial enterprises are considered. It is shown that in Russia, in contrast to developed foreign countries, direct public financing is not enough, and the existing system of tax benefits does not have a significant impact on the activation of innovation. The system of public-private partnership proposed by a number of scientists does not imply the use of new sources of financing for innovation. To enhance the innovative activity of industrial enterprises, it is proposed to use the mechanism of "quasi-self-financing", the basis of which is the effect of innovative tax leverage. Part of the tax increase can be accumulated in special innovation funds to finance the innovation of other innovation-active enterprises. Thus, there is a new element or type of public - private partnership.

articleTitle: Technology Entrepreneurship in Russia: Universities’ Activities and Efforts
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: this paper presents survey of technology entrepreneurship in Russia and discusses recent trends and perspectives of scientific projects’ commercialization. Authors make a research in the field of technology development and promotion in transforming economy. Perspectives of technology entrepreneurship’s development in Russia are discussed.
